title: Analista De Vendas Internas Jr
description: Atuando desde 1939, a Mercury Marine se consolidou como destaque global na fabricação de motores de popa e soluções para navegação. Com presença sólida no Brasil, atuamos com foco em inovação, confiabilidade, qualidade e alto desempenho, oferecendo produtos e serviços que atendem aos mais altos padrões do mercado náutico visando a satisfação máxima de nossos clientes e usuários. A operação brasileira integra a Brunswick Corporation , um dos maiores grupos do setor marítimo mundial, e combina tecnologia de ponta com compromisso com a excelência e sustentabilidade. Buscamos um(a) ANALISTA DE VENDAS INTERNAS JR para atuar junto ao time comercial em nosso escritório no Rio de Janeiro e contribuir no fortalecimento do time de operação de vendas, o relacionamento com clientes e a interface com diferentes áreas da empresa. Por favor, leia atentamente a descrição da vaga e candidate-se SOMENTE caso você atenda os pré-requisitos . Principais atividades: Emitir e acompanhar pedidos de vendas, garantindo informações corretas de preços, prazos e especificações; Prestar suportea clientes internos e externos, esclarecendo dúvidas sobre pedidos, disponibilidade de produtos e remessas; Coordenar o fluxo de pedidos junto às áreas de Supply Chain e Financeiro, assegurando o faturamento e a entrega; Atualizar informações comerciais e apoiar processos de importação quando necessário; Monitorar remessas e manter clientes informados sobre o status das entregas; Atuar em parceria com as equipes de Vendas e Financeiro para garantir agilidade nos processos e atendimento às necessidades dos clientes; Contribuir paraa melhoria contínua dos processos, propondo procedimentos e padronizações para otimizar o fluxo de vendas. Para essa posição, o que o profissional precisa ser/ter? Ter ensino superior completo em Administração, Engenharia de Produção ou áreas correlatas. Ter inglês intermediário Ter domínio do Pacote Office, especialmente Excel. Desejável ter conhecimento em sistemas ERP (Dynamics AX será considerado um diferencial) Quanto às soft skills, buscamos alguém que tenha: Boa comunicação e habilidade para se relacionar com pessoas de diferentes níveis da organização e com nossa carteira de clientes em todo o Brasil; Afinidade com números, planilhas e ferramentas de análise de dados, especialmente Excel; Interesse em aprender continuamente; Facilidade paratrabalhar em equipe; Capacidade de solucionar problemas e propor soluções; Perfil organizado e analítico. É legal saber que... Buscamos oferecer um ambiente de trabalho agradável ao nosso time Trabalhamos no modelo híbrido: 2 dias de home office e 3 dias presenciais. A quarta-feira é nosso dia fixo de trabalho presencial. Adotamos jornada flexível, de segunda a sexta-feira, totalizando 40 horas semanais. Temos ginástica laboral 2 vezes por semana no escritório Pacote de remuneração (Salário + benefícios): Alelo Multi benefícios R$2.452,40 (por mês, sem desconto e mantido nas férias); Plano de saúde (colaborador e dependentes, sem desconto em folha e sem coparticipação); Plano odontológico (colaborador e dependentes, sem desconto em folha e sem coparticipação); Seguro de vida em grupo; Vale transporteou Vale Estacionamento; Day-off de aniversário; Convênios e parcerias; > > > Modelo de contratação: vaga terceirizada, por meio do Grupo Seres, em contrato por tempo indeterminado. Sobre o processo seletivo, é constituído por algumas etapas, sendo: 1ª etapa: análise e triagem de currículos 2ª etapa: entrevista com RH - análise para aderência à vaga + testagem de inglês 3ª etapa: entrevista com gestor direto - somente os candidatos previamente aprovados 4ª etapa: entrevista com diretor da área - somente finalista(s)

title: Business Development & Marketing
description: About iQIYI iQIYI International is a global digital entertainment platform focused on Asian dramas, films, animation, variety shows and other content for international audiences. In Brazil and Latin America, we are building partnerships with leading media, telecom, digital platforms and brands to make Asian entertainment more accessible to local audiences. Role purpose Support iQIYI’s expansion in Brazil and Latin America by prospecting, developing and coordinating commercial and marketing partnerships. The role requires the ability to independently organize priorities, lead meetings, prepare proposals, follow up on opportunities and coordinate projects with external partners and internal teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia, without constant supervision. Key responsibilities 1. Business Development & Partnerships – approximately 70% Map, prospect and develop relationships with private and public free-to-air broadcasters, telecommunications operators, digital and OTT platforms, distributors, technology companies, payment providers, retailers, consumer brands and other strategic partners. Build and maintain an organized pipeline of potential partners in Brazil and other Latin American markets, documenting contacts, opportunity stages, next steps, risks and timelines. Prepare presentations, commercial proposals, preliminary partnership models, meeting minutes, progress reports and decision-support materials. Lead initial meetings, identify partner needs and develop value propositions suited to different cooperation models. Support negotiations involving content distribution, licensing, revenue sharing, subscription bundles, media/barter, co-marketing, customer benefits, promotions and other commercial models. Negotiate commercial terms within approved parameters and coordinate validation with the Country Manager and relevant iQIYI functions; final approvals and signatures remain with management and headquarters. Coordinate the progress of opportunities with internal content, marketing, product, technology, legal, finance, operations and other teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia. Support partnership implementation after approval, ensuring alignment on scope, deliverables, timelines and performance indicators. Conduct research on markets, competitors, potential partners and trends across streaming, television, telecommunications and entertainment in Latin America. Represent iQIYI in partner meetings, industry events and business visits, with availability for occasional travel within Brazil and Latin America. 2. Marketing Partnerships – approximately 30% Identify and structure marketing opportunities with commercial partners to promote the iQIYI brand, priority content launches and subscription offers. Plan and coordinate co-marketing initiatives, partner campaigns, events, activations, content promotion and online/offline promotional projects. Adapt global briefs and materials to the needs of Brazil and other Latin American markets, ensuring local relevance and compliance with brand guidelines. Coordinate deliverables with internal and external stakeholders, including partners, agencies, public relations teams, influencers and vendors when applicable. Track execution and results, gather evidence of delivery and prepare reports with learnings and recommendations. Required qualifications At least 3 years of experience in business development, partnerships, commercial roles, partnership marketing or related functions. Hands-on experience in B2B prospecting, relationship management, proposal preparation and follow-up of negotiations or partner projects. Fluent or native Portuguese. Professional English, with the ability to participate in meetings, prepare presentations and communicate with international teams. Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, set priorities, meet deadlines and keep stakeholders informed. Strong verbal and written communication, negotiation, organization and relationship-building skills. Availability to collaborate across time zones and travel occasionally within Brazil and Latin America. Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, International Relations, Economics or a related field. Proficiency in PowerPoint/Google Slides and Excel/Google Sheets; familiarity with CRM and project-management tools is preferred. Preferred qualifications Experience in streaming, entertainment, television, media, telecommunications, technology or digital platforms. Professional Spanish for communication with partners across Latin America. Existing relationships with broadcasters, telecom operators, platforms, agencies, brands or other potential partners. Experience working in multicultural environments and with international headquarters or regional teams. Knowledge of licensing, revenue-share, subscription bundles, co-marketing and media/barter models. Mandarin Chinese. Experience working with Chinese companies and a strong understanding of Chinese corporate culture will be considered a distinct advantage. Employment conditions and benefits Permanent CLT employment agreement. Initially remote work, with the possibility that the work model may be reviewed in the future, including hybrid or office-based arrangements, in accordance with business needs, company policy and applicable law. Quarterly bonus in accordance with company policy and individual/corporate performance. Health insurance plan, meal/food allowance and life insurance. 30 calendar days of paid annual leave, 13th-month salary, FGTS, INSS and other statutory benefits under Brazilian law. Applicable statutory leave and occupational health examinations.

title: Estagiário(A) Gastronomia
description: Venha viver nosso propósito! Na Hyatt, somos movidos pelo propósito de "cuidar das pessoas para que elas possam ser o seu melhor". Nossa promessa está em entregarmos grandes experiências para nossos clientes, colegas e para a sociedade baseada em nossos valores. · Ser íntegro nos torna diferentes pois estamos prontos para falar e aceitar a verdade, honrando com os compromissos, responsabilidades e orgulho; · Somos empáticospois antes de qualquer coisa, nos colocamos no lugar das pessoas com compaixão e honestidade; · Buscamos a todoinstante ver as coisas de uma forma diferente, nos tornando criativos, curiosos e experimentando sem medo. Acreditamos que as falhas existem e são elas que nos levam ao sucesso mais cedo; · Prezamos por umambiente de descontração, rimos alto e geramos a alegria em nosso ambiente de trabalho. Cultivar um ambiente saudável, alegre e de bem estar é a chave para um serviço de excelência! Sobre a oportunidade: Buscamos um(a) Estagiário(a) de Gastronomia apaixonado(a) pela arte culinária e pela hospitalidade de alto padrão para integrar nossa equipe. Esta é uma excelente oportunidade para desenvolver habilidades práticas em um ambiente sofisticado, acompanhando profissionais experientes e contribuindo para a excelência dos serviços gastronômicos oferecidos aos hóspedes e clientes. Principais Responsabilidades : Apoiar o preparo e a finalização de alimentos sob supervisão da equipe de cozinha; Auxiliar na organização e abastecimento das praças de trabalho; Contribuir paraa montagem de pratos conforme os padrões de apresentação do hotel; Auxiliar no controle e armazenamento correto de insumos e alimentos; Apoiar a equipedurante cafés da manhã, eventos, banquetes e operações de restaurantes; Zelar pelo cumprimento das normas de segurança alimentar, higiene e boas práticas de manipulação; Participar de treinamentos e atividades de desenvolvimento da área. Requisitos Cursando Gastronomia, Tecnólogo em Gastronomia ou áreas correlatas; Disponibilidadepara estagiar 6 horas diárias; Interesse em gastronomia contemporânea, alta gastronomia e hotelaria de luxo; Conhecimento básico em técnicas culinárias e boas práticas de manipulação de alimentos; Benefícios: Plano de saúde e Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Transporte ou Auxílio combustível de acordo com as suas necessidades; WellHub para atividades voltadas para saúde e bem-estar; Uniforme lavadoe passado em nossa Lavanderia; Alimentação realizada no hotel; Kit recém-nascido; Convênio com Drogaria Pacheco; Convênio com instituições de ensino Superior, cursos de idioma e Informática; Parceria com restaurantes próximos ao hotel; Desconto nos serviços oferecidos pelo hotel (Restaurantes e SPA); Oportunidades de Encarreiramento. Pensamos em benefícios que impactem positivamente o bem-estar e saúde de nossos colaboradores, então também oferecemos: Atendimento médico e psicológico gratuito no hotel (conforme agendamento) Sessões de Shiatsu gratuitas no hotel (conforme agendamento) Parceria com plataforma Psicologia Viva, com sessões gratuitas Manicure (conforme agendamento) Barbeiro (conforme agendamento) Acreditamos na construção de um ambiente inclusivo. Por isso, todas as nossas oportunidades são extensivas a pessoas com deficiência (PCD).

title: Process And Automation Consultant (3 Months)
description: We are seeking a Process and Automation Consultant – RPA Specialist to join a three‑month advisory engagement that supports the migration of the core pricing system. The consultant will own the end‑to‑end documentation of current pricing and agreement processes, uncover manual pain points, and design automation‑ready future‑state workflows. The role reports to the engagement lead and works closely with operational teams, the client’s internal stakeholders, and external implementation vendors. Key Responsibilities Document current‑state end‑to‑end pricing and agreement processes, including handoffs, exception paths, and workarounds. Quantify manual effort, cycle times, rework, and error rates using available data sources. Conduct structured process‑discovery workshops with operational teams to surface bottlenecks and improvement ideas. Identify and evaluate automation opportunities (RPA, workflow orchestration, rules‑based validation) and assess their long‑term viability. Design future‑state workflow alternatives that support agreement intake, validation, approval, and publication. Prioritize automation and redesign initiatives with effort, impact, and risk estimates. Distinguish automation that resolves root causes from automation that merely masks underlying process defects. Produce validated documentation and present findings to senior stakeholders for decision‑making. ✅ Job Requirements Minimum 6 years of experience in business process analysis, process improvement, or intelligent‑automation consulting. Advanced English proficiency (C1 level) with strong written and verbal communication skills. Proven ability to create process maps using BPMN, value‑stream mapping, SIPOC, or comparable techniques. Hands‑on experience delivering RPA solutions with platforms such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Power Automate, or similar. Demonstrated capability to lead and facilitate structured workshops with cross‑functional operational teams. Strong analytical skills to quantify manual effort, cycle times, and error rates. Preferred Skills Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification. Direct experience in pricing, rebates, or order‑to‑cash operations. Exposure to process‑mining tools such as Celonis or comparable solutions. Familiarity with workflow‑orchestration platforms (e.G., Camunda, Microsoft Power Automate).

title: Analista Fp&A - Sênior
description: Sobre a Bloquo A Bloquo atua na construção de infraestrutura financeira para operações envolvendo ativos digitais, pagamentos internacionais e serviços financeiros . Estamos em um momento de crescimento e estruturação da companhia, incluindo a preparação para atuação como Sociedade Prestadora de Serviços de Ativos Virtuais (SPSVA) . Buscamos um(a) Analista de FP&A para apoiar o planejamento financeiro, acompanhamento de resultados e análise de desempenho da companhia, transformando dados financeiros e operacionais em informações que apoiem a tomada de decisão. A posição terá atuação próxima à liderança e às áreas do negócio, com foco em planejamento, análise de resultados, projeções e construção de cenários . Principais responsabilidades Conduzir o ciclo de budget, forecast e planejamento financeiro da companhia, apoiando a liderança na sua construção e acompanhamento; Elaborar e analisar o P&L gerencial, acompanhando receitas, custos, despesas, margens e a rentabilidade de operações, produtos e clientes; Realizar as análises de realizado vs. orçado vs. forecast, identificando desvios, causas e impactos nos resultados; Desenvolver e manter modelos financeiros, projeções e cenários para apoiar decisões estratégicas, incluindo novos produtos e iniciativas; Acompanhar indicadores financeiros e operacionais, identificando tendências, oportunidades e pontos de atenção; Preparar relatórios gerenciais e apresentações executivas para a liderança; Atuar como parceiro de Contabilidade, Comercial, Operações e demais áreas para entender os drivers do negócio e traduzi-los em impacto financeiro; Extrair, organizar e tratar informações financeiras e operacionais de ERP, sistemas internos e demais fontes de dados; Desenvolver e aprimorar dashboards, controles e modelos de análise; Contribuir parainiciativas de automação e melhoria dos processos de planejamento e reporting. Requisitos Formação em Administração, Economia, Contabilidade, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas; 4–6+ anos de experiência em FP&A, Planejamento Financeiro, Controladoria ou áreas correlatas; Sólido conhecimento de P&L/DRE, fluxo de caixa, indicadores financeiros e análise de resultados; Experiência combudget, forecast e análise de variações; Domínio de modelagem financeira e construção de cenários; Excel avançado; Forte capacidade analítica e de interpretação de dados; Boa comunicação, com clareza e objetividade ao apresentar análises para diferentes públicos; Perfil analítico, organizado, curioso e orientado a resultados, com autonomia para conduzir suas entregas. Diferenciais Experiência em fintechs, instituições financeiras, empresas de pagamentos ou ativos virtuais; Experiência em ambientes regulados e/ou com o Banco Central; Conhecimento deoperações com criptoativos e stablecoins; Conhecimento dePower BI, Power Query e/ou SQL; Experiência comanálise de viabilidade e valuation de iniciativas; Inglês avançado; Conhecimento de operações internacionais. O que oferecemos Swile Multibenefícios ; Gympass , incentivando saúde e bem-estar; Ambiente dinâmico, com autonomia e espaço para desenvolvimento ; Atuação próximaà liderança e exposição a diferentes áreas do negócio; Oportunidade detrabalhar com ativos digitais, infraestrutura financeira e operações internacionais ; Possibilidade de participar ativamente da construção e evolução dos processos financeiros da companhia . Local: Rio de Janeiro – RJ Modelo: Híbrido – Copacabana

title: Immigration Paralegal (Immigration Court / Removal Defense)
description: Are you ready to build a meaningful career defending immigrants facing deportation? Do you thrive in fast‑paced environments, stay calm under pressure, and want to fight for people who need it most? If so, Bueno Law wants to meet you. About Bueno Law Bueno Law is a Queer‑owned immigration law firm dedicated to protecting LGBTQ+ immigrants, survivors of domestic violence and human trafficking, and other marginalized communities. We specialize in: Removal Defense (EOIR). Asylum & Humanitarian Relief (U/T visas, VAWA, SIJS). Family‑Based Immigration. We’re expanding our Removal Defense Team and seeking passionate, detail‑driven Paralegals committed to making a real impact. What You’ll Do (Removal Defense Focus) Support EOIR litigation by preparing filings, motions, briefs, and applications for relief (asylum, cancellation, waivers, adjustment, etc.). Draft client declarations and gather evidence for high‑stakes court submissions. Manage a removal‑defense caseload, track deadlines, and maintain accurate case records. Prepare hearing packets, organize exhibits, and assist attorneys with trial preparation. Communicate with clients—often in emotionally sensitive situations—to collect facts and provide updates. Coordinate with interpreters, experts, and agencies to support case strategy. Prepare and file USCIS petitions for clients with mixed EOIR/USCIS matters. What We’re Looking For Hard Skills Fluent in English + Spanish or Portuguese. 3 years experience in with end to end removal defense (need experience with litigation). Strong legal writing, research, and evidence‑gathering skills. Highly organized and detail‑oriented with the ability to manage a heavy caseload. Tech‑savvy and fully equipped for remote work (computer, internet, private workspace, noise‑canceling headphones). Soft Skills Emotionally intelligent communicator who can support clients during stressful moments. Thrives in fast‑paced, mission‑driven environments. Team‑oriented, proactive, adaptable, and solutions‑focused. A sense of humor—because the work is intense, and we believe in supporting each other. Preferred Qualifications 3 + years of immigration paralegal experience. Experience with both EOIR and USCIS filings. What We Offer Competitive pay above market rate. Paid vacation + sick leave. Your birthday off. U.S. paid holidays. Mon–Fri, 9 AM–6 PM PST. A mission‑driven, inclusive, supportive team.

title: Administrador(A) De Dados Senior
description: Buscamos um(a) Administrador(a) de Dados Sênior com experiência sólida em administração e modelagem de dados, conhecimento em negócios bancários e atuação com framework BIAN, arquitetura orientada a eventos (EDA), Apache Kafka e governança de eventos . Requisitos Experiência e conhecimentos técnicos Experiência sólida em administração e modelagem de dados ; Conhecimento de negócios bancários , principalmente em assuntos como Cheque Especial, Conta e Pagamentos ; Conhecimento prático e aplicável do framework BIAN ; Experiência com arquitetura orientada a eventos (EDA) e Apache Kafka ; Conhecimento em governança de eventos , incluindo definição de contratos, versionamento e políticas de compatibilidade; Experiência na modelagem e gestão de schemas AVRO (Schema Registry) ; Conhecimento em esteiras CI/CD ; Familiaridade com ferramentas de modelagem de dados como Erwin, PowerDesigner ou similares ; Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL ; Entendimento e aplicação de normas de compliance e privacidade de dados , incluindo LGPD e GDPR . title: Video Editor
description: Ten16 Creative is a boutique creative agency that builds campaigns, brand systems, and content for technology and AI-driven companies. We work with brands you've heard of and some you're about to. We're looking for a Video Editor + Motion Designer based in Brazil to join our team full-time. This is a remote position reporting directly to our Creative Director. What you'll do: Edit video content for campaigns, social, product launches, and brand storytelling Create motion graphics, from logo animations to full explainer sequences Experiment with AI video tools (Runway, Higgsfield, etc.) to push creative boundaries Deliver across formats: 16:9, 9:16, 1:1 — for web, social, ads, and beyond Work fast, think creatively, and bring your own ideas to the project. We value your perspective! What we're looking for: Strong portfolio showing both video editing and motion graphics work Proficiency in After Effects, Premiere (or similar NLE) Experience with (or genuine curiosity about) AI-generated video tools Ability to work independently, manage your time, and meet deadlines Great taste in design, knowledge of the latest video editing trends and styles. Bonus points: Experience creating content for tech, SaaS, or consumer brands, Basis English. But don't worry, your teammates are also based in Brazil. We use the latest AI tools to move fast and deliver high-quality work for ambitious companies. If you want creative freedom, variety, and the chance to grow with us, please don't hesitate to apply. ------ Estamos Contratando: Editor de Vídeo / Motion Designer (Brasil, Remoto) A Ten16 Creative é uma agência criativa boutique que desenvolve campanhas, sistemas de marca e conteúdo para empresas de tecnologia e inteligência artificial. Trabalhamos com marcas que você já conhece — e algumas que está prestes a conhecer. Estamos procurando um Editor de Vídeo + Motion Designer baseado no Brasil para integrar nosso time em tempo integral. A posição é 100% remota, com reporte direto ao nosso Diretor Criativo. title: Professor De Educação Física
description: Job overview We are looking for an experienced and qualified Physical Education teacher to join our Primary Section P.E Department at our Botafogo Site. We are seeking a dedicated educator to focus initially on teaching UK Key Stages 1 and 2, promoting sportsmanship, teamwork, and students’ overall well-being. Responsibilities Child Psychomotor Development: A deep understanding of body schemes, laterality, balance, and gross motor coordination for children aged 2 to 11 mainly. International Curricula and Methodologies: Familiarity with frameworks such as the EYFS (Early Years Foundation Stage) from the British curriculum Familiarity in international curricula like the IPC (International Primary Curriculum) , Cambridge Primary / International Baccalaureate (IB). Understanding the Transition from Early Years to Key Stage 1 / Primary A child-centered and play-based learning approach through movement and active games. Differentiation and Inclusion: Ability to design activity stations that accommodate different physical maturity levels. Introduction to Basic Game Rules & Sports Literacy: Ability to teach simplified versions of team sports (mainly volleyball, basketball, futsal and handball), cooperative games, gymnastics, track & field (athletics), and rhythm and movement. Spatial & Tactical Awareness: Teaching children how to share space, understand boundaries, play offense/defense in simple games, and follow rules safely. First Aid & CPR: Practically mandatory in international schools to manage safety during physical activities with young children. Child Protection & Safeguarding Training: A standard required certification across schools with British or American international curricula. Energy, Patience, and Empathy: Ability to lead high-energy classes while maintaining a safe, welcoming, and dynamic environment. Classroom Management in Open Spaces: Skill in keeping group attention and maintaining discipline through clear rules in gymnasiums or outdoors. Intercultural Sensitivity: Ability to work effectively with families and students from diverse nationalities and cultural backgrounds. Encouraging Sportsmanship & Teamwork: Guiding children through winning and losing gracefully, resolving minor conflict, and encouraging inclusive play. Formal Progress Tracking & Reporting: Experience with assessing movement competency, tracking individual progress against curriculum standards, and writing formal student reports for parents. Behavior Management: Ability to maintain structure and focus in larger spaces (gyms/fields) using clear routines, time-management techniques, and positive reinforcement for students. Key Requirements A degree and a teaching qualification in Physical Education (Licenciatura) Active registration - CREF. Fluency in English (C1 level) The candidate must reside in Brazil. Secure subject knowledge in Physical Education. Proven ability to teach UK Key Stages 1 and 2 effectively. Experience working in a school setting.

title: Crypto Operations Specialist
description: About us Diversas Vagas is a recruitment agency working with companies in fintech, digital assets and online payments. We handle hiring for partners who need people with real technical experience, not just a matching keyword on a CV. This role is open at one of our partner companies, a digital asset business with a distributed team, and we are running the search and the first stages of the process. About the role Our partner is looking for a Crypto Operations Specialist to own their daily crypto operations. You will be the person responsible for making sure funds move correctly, safely and on time. What you will do Handle incoming and outgoing crypto transfers, conversions between assets, and movement of funds between wallets and exchange accounts. Work with non-custodial wallets (MetaMask, Trust Wallet, Safe, hardware wallets) across several networks, including Ethereum, Tron, BNB Chain, Solana, Polygon and Arbitrum. Manage company accounts on major exchanges: deposits and withdrawals, spot conversions, withdrawal limits, address whitelisting, account verification and support tickets. Choose the right network for each transfer, check fees before sending, and run test transactions before larger amounts go out. Monitor transactions through block explorers, confirm settlements, and investigate transfers that are delayed, stuck or failed. Keep accurate records of every operation, reconcile wallet and exchange balances daily, and prepare regular reports for the finance team. Follow and improve internal security procedures: seed phrase and key handling, hardware wallet use, two-factor authentication, access rights, separation of hot and cold storage. Review operations for anything unusual, follow AML and KYC procedures, and escalate anything that looks wrong before it becomes a problem. Work closely with finance, product and support. You will be the person other teams come to with questions about crypto payments, so clear communication matters here. Help document the process. The company wants procedures written down, not kept in someone's head. What we are looking for At least 2 years of hands-on experience in crypto. This is not a role for someone who has only traded on the side. Real practical experience with non-custodial wallets. You should be comfortable managing keys, setting up multisig, connecting to different networks and recovering access when something goes wrong. Experience working with centralized exchanges, including withdrawals, deposits, verification and limits. Solid understanding of crypto asset security and common attack methods: phishing, fake sites, address poisoning, malicious contract approvals. Strong attention to detail. A wrong network or one wrong character in an address is money gone, and we need someone who checks twice by habit. Ability to work independently, keep your own records in order and report clearly on what you did. Working level of English for internal communication and exchange support. Stable internet connection and your own computer. Nice to have Experience with DeFi protocols, bridges and stablecoin flows. Familiarity with blockchain analytics tools such as Chainalysis or similar. Previous work in fintech, payments or an exchange. Confident with spreadsheets and basic reporting. What the role offers Salary: $240,000 – $270,000 per year Paid vacation Full medical insurance Remote work with flexible hours, as long as key operations are covered Equipment and hardware wallets covered by the company Budget for professional courses and certifications Small team, direct communication, no long approval chains

title: Qc Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil
description: About Us Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens. At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact. Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide. Role Overview As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives. Key Responsibilities 1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval. 2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration. 3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble 4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback. Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions. 5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines. 6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards. 7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows. 8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology 9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content within defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content. 10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to: Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible. Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements. Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork. Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis. Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

title: Data Specialist (With Advanced English)
description: About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence. We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery. About the Role: We’re currently working on expanding our Central Data Team to increase our product portfolio with members who build, create and maintain our data products. Those with strong analytical skills who are passionate about data and excited to scale quickly to deliver top-tier products to our clients are encouraged to apply. The Data Specialist plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs . Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Specialist works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale. See this short video to learn more about our organization, product, and why some of our current Data Specialists love working here! As Our Data Specialist, you will: Take ownership of high-impact work with guidance — whether that’s running or building data products end-to-end, supporting centralized data ingestion pipelines the broader team relies on, or building clean, granular data feeds that help clients dive into data. Work with massive amounts of data to answer our clients’ key questions about the companies we cover and datasets we analyze. You’ll learn our proprietary methods and techniques, building the judgment and mental models to understand why our data works — not just how to produce it. Use AI and tooling to accelerate your learning and work — assisting with queries, investigations, debugging, and repetitive tasks. You’ll develop the habit of validating AI-generated outputs rather than assuming correctness, building a foundation for using AI effectively throughout your career here. Become a trusted resource for internal stakeholders and clients , working with them to identify and answer key questions. You’ll contribute to data feeds, custom analyses, and reports consumed by the top investors in the world. Improve the products, pipelines, and data feeds you own — we value curiosity and experimentation, and we expect you to follow established best practices while also questioning the status quo and identifying opportunities for improvement. Learn or sharpen SQL, Python, and PySpark skills starting with our two-month new hire training program covering technical fundamentals as well as our internal tools and processes. You Are Likely To Succeed If: You have a strong ownership mentality — you want to ensure our products are the best in the world and take personal responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks You have strong attention to detail and produce work with minimal errors You communicate clearly, both orally and in writing — including proactively sharing progress, blockers, and updates You strive to make tasks as efficient as possible and are excited about using AI and tooling to work smarter You can manage multiple priorities and stay organized You are experimental and curious — energized by learning and not afraid to change the status quo You are enthusiastic about making a big impact at a rapidly growing company What We Offer: Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary: We care about your personal life and we mean it. We offer vacation time, team events and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) Personal laptop Health and wellness package Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Colombia/Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Digital Designer (Marketing)

We're looking for a Digital Designer (Marketing) to join our team and work primarily with our retainer clients. Unlike project-based work, you'll develop deep, ongoing relationships with a portfolio of clients, becoming an extension of their marketing teams and developing an intimate understanding of their brands, audiences, and business goals. You'll report to both the Design Team Lead and Head of Creative and Strategy, working across a wide range of marketing assets. This role requires a designer who thrives on variety, works quickly without sacrificing quality, and has a deep understanding of marketing asset creation across digital channels. Key Responsibilities Marketing Asset Creation Designing social media content across platforms (, Instagram, Twitter/X, Facebook), including static posts, carousels, and stories Creating webinar and event graphics, including promotional banners, registration pages, presentation templates, and recap assets Developing one-pagers, sell sheets, and product/feature overviews Designing email headers, newsletter templates, and digital campaign assets Creating infographics, data visualizations, and report layouts Designing blog graphics, featured images, and content marketing visuals Producing landing page designs and website banners Creating presentation decks for sales, investors, and internal use Designing trade show and event collateral (booth graphics, handouts, signage) Adapting and resizing assets for multiple formats and platforms Brand Stewardship Maintaining brand consistency across all touchpoints for assigned clients Building and maintaining template libraries and asset repositories Contributing to design system development and documentation Evolving client brands within established guidelines while keeping them fresh Collaboration & Process Working under the supervision of the Design Team Lead while maintaining direct communication with leadership Collaborating closely with Account Managers to understand client priorities and deadlines Managing multiple client requests simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail Participating in client calls and incorporating feedback quickly Working efficiently within retainer hour allocations Key KPIs Operational Efficiency: Deviation from estimates 10% Client Satisfaction (CSAT): Average score 4.7+ Internal Quality Score: Average score 4.7+ Client Creative Feedback: Average score 4.7+ Turnaround Time: Meeting SLAs for retainer deliverables Requirements 3-5+ years of experience in marketing design, preferably at an agency or in-house marketing team Deep experience with marketing asset types: social media graphics, webinar materials, one-pagers, email templates, presentations, infographics Strong understanding of social media platforms and their design requirements/best practices Expert proficiency in Figma (primary tool) Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign) Proficiency with AI tools Experience with motion/animation tools a plus (After Effects, Lottie) Ability to work quickly and efficiently without sacrificing quality Excellent attention to detail and ability to maintain brand consistency Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple client accounts Comfortable with remote collaboration via Slack, video calls, and project management tools Strong portfolio demonstrating range across marketing asset types Nice to Have Experience working with B2B technology brands Basic motion design / animation skills Experience with HubSpot, Marketo, or other marketing automation platforms Understanding of conversion-focused design principles Experience building and maintaining design systems The Perks Diverse team (team members are based in US, UK, Europe, Canada, LATAM) Working with interesting clients in the technology space Fully remote A highly cooperative team that encourages professional growth and self-development Salary is commensurate with experience and market-rate at the candidate's location To be considered, apply with your cover letter, CV, and portfolio.

title: Gerente de operações logística
description: Estamos em expansão para o Rio de Janeiro - RJ na região de (Duque de Caixas), e em busca de um Gerente de Operações Logística para liderar uma operação de alta complexidade, com foco em centro de distribuição, transportes, gestão de estoques e melhoria contínua, garantindo eficiência operacional, excelência no atendimento e desenvolvimento das equipes. Buscamos uma liderança com forte visão estratégica e operacional, capaz de transformar desafios em resultados, desenvolver equipes de alta performance e impulsionar uma operação logística cada vez mais eficiente, escalável e preparada para sustentar o crescimento da Swift. Principais responsabilidades: Liderar as operações de centro de distribuição, transportes e gestão de estoques, assegurando elevados níveis de serviço, produtividade e segurança operacional. Garantir a excelência da operação logística em uma cadeia de abastecimento com produtos congelados e secos, preservando a integridade da cadeia fria e a disponibilidade dos produtos. Desenvolver e implementar estratégias logísticas alinhadas ao crescimento do negócio, suportando a expansão da operação e o aumento da capacidade logística. Gerenciar o orçamento da área, acompanhando custos operacionais, investimentos e oportunidades de ganho de eficiência. Definir, acompanhar e analisar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs), promovendo planos de ação para melhoria contínua. Garantir elevados níveis de acuracidade dos estoques e excelência nos processos de recebimento, armazenagem, separação, expedição e distribuição. Liderar operações de abastecimento para lojas, e-commerce e demais canais de venda, assegurando disponibilidade, qualidade e nível de serviço. Gerenciar parceiros logísticos, transportadoras e operadores, acompanhando performance, contratos e SLAs. Liderar gestores e equipes multidisciplinares, promovendo uma cultura de alta performance, desenvolvimento e segurança. Conduzir projetos de transformação logística, automação, digitalização e melhoria contínua, buscando aumento de produtividade e redução de custos. Atuar de forma integrada com supply chain, comercial, operações, planejamento, tecnologia, compras, finanças e recursos humanos. Elaborar análises executivas e apresentações gerenciais para suporte à tomada de decisão da alta liderança. Pré Requisitos: Necessário experiência em operações logísticas de grande porte, em varejo alimentar, supermercados, atacarejo, food service, indústria de alimentos ou operações de cadeia fria. Vivência na gestão de centros de distribuição de alta complexidade, abastecimento de lojas e operações de distribuição. Forte experiência na liderança de gestores, coordenadores e grandes equipes operacionais. Histórico consistente de melhoria de indicadores de produtividade, nível de serviço, custos e eficiência operacional. Experiência com gestão orçamentária, planejamento operacional e tomada de decisão baseada em indicadores. Domínio de KPIs logísticos como OTIF, produtividade, acuracidade de estoque, nível de serviço, custo logístico, ocupação e eficiência operacional. Conhecimento em sistemas WMS, TMS, SAP e ERP. Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia, Logística, Administração ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação ou MBA será considerada um diferencial. Excel avançado. Venha fazer parte deste time!Se você se identifica com esse desafio e quer construir uma carreira em uma empresa que valoriza pessoas, inovação e excelência, candidate-se à vaga. Siga a página da Swift no Linked In e acompanhe nossas oportunidades de carreira. Quem sabe a sua próxima grande oportunidade não está aqui?

title: Sales manager - power generation
description: We are looking for an experienced Business Development Manager to drive the growth of our Power Generation business in Brazil. This role is ideal for professionals with a strong background in gas turbine power generation, gas engine generator sets, or power generation equipment, who are passionate about developing new business opportunities and building long-term customer relationships. What You'll Do: Develop new business opportunities for gas power generation equipment and solutions. Build and maintain strong relationships with industrial end users, channel partners, and key stakeholders. Identify and develop opportunities in distributed energy and captive power generation. Manage the complete sales process, from opportunity identification to commercial negotiation and contract award. Work closely with engineering and technical teams to deliver customer-focused power generation solutions. Analyze market trends and identify strategic growth opportunities across Brazil. What We're Looking For: Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline. At least 5 years of business development or technical sales experience in the power generation industry. Strong knowledge of gas turbines, gas engine generator sets, and power generation equipment. Experience selling power generation equipment or energy solutions to industrial customers. Established relationships with industrial end users are highly desirable. Strong commercial awareness, negotiation, and communication skills. Fluent English (spoken and written). Willingness to travel throughout Brazil. Preferred Background Candidates with experience in the following areas are especially encouraged to apply: Gas turbine power generation Gas engine generator sets Power generation equipment manufacturing Energy technology companies Distributed power generation solutions Existing customer relationships in industries such as Oil & Gas, Data Centers, Mining, Manufacturing, Utilities, and other industrial sectors will be considered a strong advantage. Location: Brazil Rio de Janeiro and San Paulo

title: Especialista em camunda
description: Se você é uma Pessoa Especialista em Camunda (8), vem ver essa oportunidade: A posição é para um projeto estratégico de arquitetura e integração de processos corporativos. Terá como foco a estruturação do Camunda 8 Self-Managed em Azure, conectando diferentes sistemas e estabelecendo padrões de integração, segurança, documentação e governança. Seu dia a dia: Desenhar a arquitetura do Camunda 8 Self-Managed em Azure, contemplando ambientes, dimensionamento, segurança, autenticação e CI/CD. Definir padrões de integração, nomenclatura, versionamento e responsabilidades de dados entre os sistemas. Implantar e configurar Zeebe, Operate, Tasklist, Optimize, Identity, Web Modeler e Connectors. Estruturar monitoramento, logs, auditoria e estratégias de backup e restore. Elaborar documentação técnica, incluindo arquitetura, especificações de integração, guias de implementação e mapas de integrações. Capacitar a equipe interna sobre arquitetura, operação e padrões de desenvolvimento. Avaliar recursos de IA do Camunda, considerando capacidades, limitações e custos. O que você precisa ter: Camunda (7 e/ou 8), com experiência em pelo menos 1 projeto Camunda 8 Self-Managed em produção. Domínio dos principais componentes do Camunda 8 e suas APIs. Domínio de BPMN 2.0 executável, DMN e FEEL. Experiência prática com Kubernetes/Helm e Azure/AKS. Experiência com OIDC/OAuth 2.0 e integrações corporativas complexas. Conhecimento de Elasticsearch ou Open Search. Capacidade comprovada de produzir documentação técnica formal. Um diferencial: Certificação Camunda. Perfil que dá match com o time: Uma pessoa consultiva, autônoma, comunicativa e didática, com facilidade para definir padrões, tomar decisões arquiteturais e compartilhar conhecimento com o time. Superior completo em TI ou correlatas. Modelo remoto (com eventuais encontros presenciais no RJ). CLT + Benefícios e Incentivos: Saúde e Bem-estar: Assistências Médica e Odontológica (Sul América), Seguro de Vida (Prudential), Previdência Privada (Onze) e acesso ao Well Hub para cuidar da mente e do corpo, além do VR de ~R$ 850,00 no Caju. Desenvolvimento: Coparticipação na assinatura do Alura, ajuda para cursos de inglês, Ciclo de Avaliação de Desempenho com Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI), programas internos de mentoria e capacitação profissional. Equilíbrio: Com nosso benefício de Antecipação de Férias, quem tem entre 6 e 12 meses de contrato pode aproveitar o descanso sem perder esse direito ao mudar de emprego. Diversidade e Inclusão: Todas as nossas oportunidades são elegíveis para pessoas com deficiência. Sobre a Elumini Somos uma consultoria sólida no mercado de TI, com operações na América do Sul, América do Norte e Europa. Certificada pelo Great Place to Work, somos reconhecidos por nossa forma única de valorizar profissionais e promover um ambiente diferenciado. Candidate-se e decole sua carreira, venha ser Eluminer!

title: Assistente de rh
description: NECESSÁRIA EXPERIÊNCIA MÍNIMA DE 03 ANOS!NECESSÁRIO TER EXPERTISE EM GESTÃO DE CLIMA ORGANIZAÇÃO, CRIAR E GERENCIAR AÇÕES PARA MELHORIA DA SATISFAÇÃO E BEM-ESTAR DOS COLABORADORES, ANÁLISE DE DESEMPENHO E SISTEMA DE CARGOS E SALÁRIOS!SALÁRIO: R$ 2.400,00 + BENEFÍCIOSRecrutamento e Seleção: Divulgar vagas, agendar entrevistas, apoiar dinâmicas e processos de contratação; Departamento Pessoal: Apoiar controle de ponto, férias, admissões, demissões, folha de pagamento e documentação; Treinamento e Desenvolvimento: Auxiliar na organização de treinamentos, integrações e avaliações de desempenho; Atendimento e Suporte: Esclarecer dúvidas de funcionários sobre benefícios, políticas internas e processos trabalhistas; Gestão de Clima Organizacional: Participar de ações para melhorar a satisfação e o bem-estar no trabalho; Administrativo: Organizar arquivos, preencher planilhas e dar suporte às atividades administrativas da empresa.

title: Coordenador de desenvolvimento humano e organizacional / dho
description: Coordenar a execução dos programas, processos e iniciativas de Desenvolvimento Humano e Organizacional, desdobrando as estratégias definidas pela Gerência de DHO em planos e entregas consistentes. Liderar e desenvolver a equipe, garantir a governança dos ciclos de pessoas e atuar de forma consultiva junto às lideranças, áreas e operações, promovendo cultura, clima, engajamento, desempenho, desenvolvimento e uma jornada positiva do colaborador, em alinhamento com as necessidades do negócio. Desdobrar as estratégias e diretrizes da Gerência de DHO em planos de trabalho, cronogramas, metas, responsabilidades e rotinas de acompanhamento. Coordenar os ciclos de gestão de desempenho, garantindo comunicação, parametrização de sistemas, orientações, controles, consolidação de resultados, qualidade das avaliações e cumprimento dos prazos. Garantir a elaboração e o acompanhamento dos Planos de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI), orientando gestores e monitorando evolução, evidências e efetividade das ações. Coordenar o diagnóstico de necessidades de treinamento e desenvolvimento, a construção do plano anual de capacitação e a implantação de trilhas por cargo, competência e público. Supervisionar treinamentos, workshops, integrações e ações de desenvolvimento, assegurando qualidade de conteúdo, logística, fornecedores, registros, avaliação e aplicação do aprendizado. Gerir indicadores de treinamento, como horas por colaborador, adesão, conclusão, satisfação e eficácia, analisando desvios e definindo ações corretivas. Coordenar pesquisas de clima, engajamento, pulso e experiência do colaborador, consolidando diagnósticos, apresentando resultados e garantindo a construção e o acompanhamento dos planos de ação. Conduzir ou supervisionar entrevistas, grupos focais, escutas estruturadas e análises de dados para identificar fatores de engajamento, riscos de clima e oportunidades de melhoria. Coordenar programas de desenvolvimento de liderança, formação de talentos, mapeamento de posições críticas, sucessão e mobilidade interna. Participar da construção e atualização de modelos de competências, descrições de cargos, trilhas de carreira e critérios de desenvolvimento e promoção. Organizar e participar dos comitês de pessoas, desempenho, carreira e sucessão, garantindo qualidade das informações, registros das decisões, encaminhamentos e prazos. Coordenar ações de cultura organizacional, valores, propósito, reconhecimento, diversidade, inclusão, pertencimento e experiência do colaborador. Planejar, em conjunto com Comunicação e demais áreas, iniciativas de comunicação interna e employer branding relacionadas aos programas de pessoas. Garantir a gestão da jornada do colaborador, do onboarding ao desenvolvimento, engajamento, reconhecimento, movimentações internas e desligamento responsável. Atuar como parceiro consultivo das lideranças, antecipando demandas, apoiando decisões de pessoas e integrando esforços com os demais subsistemas de RH. Coordenar o apoio às operações, unidades e implantações de contratos em ações de cultura, clima, integração, desenvolvimento, desempenho, retenção e gestão da mudança. Monitorar indicadores de DHO e pessoas, como turnover, absenteísmo, clima, desempenho, capacitação, mobilidade e satisfação interna, elaborando análises e recomendações para a gestão. Garantir a atualização e a confiabilidade de bases, dashboards, apresentações, relatórios gerenciais, evidências, documentos e sistemas da área. Gerir consultorias, plataformas e fornecedores de DHO, acompanhando escopo, contratos, qualidade, prazos, entregas e orçamento. Coordenar melhorias nos processos de DHO, promovendo padronização, automação, simplificação, eficiência e melhor experiência dos usuários internos. Coordenar iniciativas de transformação cultural e gestão da mudança, estruturando diagnósticos, planos de comunicação, engajamento das partes interessadas e acompanhamento da adesão. Apoiar a Gerência de DHO na construção do planejamento, do orçamento e das prioridades anuais da área, fornecendo dados, cenários e propostas. Atuar na mediação de conflitos e no apoio a situações críticas de pessoas, em conjunto com a Gerência de DHO e áreas responsáveis. Cumprir políticas internas, requisitos legais e diretrizes de proteção de dados aplicáveis aos processos e informações de pessoas. Bacharel em Psicologia, Pós em Gestão de pessoas ou áreas afins Acima de 6 anos de experiëncia na função

title: Vendedor(a) | barra shopping
description: Se junte à Zissou Sono é ritual: o tecido certo, o quarto que convida a desacelerar, a sequência de gestos antes de deitar. É nisso que a Zissou acredita, e é isso que a gente desenha em cada peça, do colchão Coral ao Blue, do travesseiro ao jogo de cama. Ritual só existe se alguém traduz ele todo dia, pra quem entra na loja. Essa pessoa é você. Você não recita ficha técnica. Você entende como alguém dorme, o que atrapalha essa noite, e monta a solução: mais firmeza ou mais maciez, resfriamento ou suporte, o ritual completo ou só o primeiro passo. Consultoria de verdade, sem roteiro decorado. Características que valorizamos Mentalidade empreendedora com protagonismo — ter olhar de dono, pedir licença e não desculpas Senso estético refinado e paixão por design — afinidade com moda, arquitetura, decoração ou um jeito próprio de cuidar dos detalhes visuais Conexão com saúde e bem-estar — estilo de vida ligado à longevidade e ao autocuidado Hospitalidade como padrão — colocar o cliente no centro de cada decisão, com a mesma atenção e cuidado de quem recebe alguém em casa Responsabilidades Receber o cliente de forma consultiva, buscando trazer a melhor solução para o perfil e as necessidades Apresentar os produtos Zissou com clareza, domínio e segurança na hora da venda Elaboração de orçamentos, acompanhamento do cliente e negociação até a conclusão da venda Construir relações de confiança e transformar cada conversa em uma venda de verdade Trabalhar com metas de vendas e acompanhar os resultados com responsabilidade Cuidar da organização da loja, mantendo tudo limpo e pronto para encantar Ajudar no controle do estoque, com conferência, organização e apoio nos inventários Requisitos Ensino médio completo Experiência com vendas no varejo, preferencialmente em lojas de shopping com oferta de produtos de alto valor agregado Boa comunicação e escuta verdadeira Organização, atenção aos detalhes e cuidado com o ambiente Proatividade, vontade de aprender e foco em metas Conhecimento em sistema de vendas (PDV) Disponibilidade para trabalhar em escala de shopping, inclusive finais de semana e feriados Jornada e escala Funcionamento da loja: das 10h às 22h, de segunda a domingo Escala de trabalho: 6x1, folga fixa na semana e domingo alternados. Jornada diária: 7h30 Remuneração e benefícios Salário fixo e comissão sobre vendas individuais Assistência médica 100% custeada para titular Assistência odontológica (opcional com valor subsidiado) Vale-refeição via Flash Vale-transporte via Flash Seguro de vida Total Pass Empréstimo consignado Consultoria financeira e jurídica (C4 Life) Plataforma de saúde (Clude) Convênio com o Sesc Desconto em produtos Zissou

title: Delivery manager - rio de janeiro
description: Ensures successful execution of client-facing company projects and services, meeting client expectations and business objectives. Oversees project planning, resource allocation and service delivery. Manages risks and resolves issues, engaging cross-functionally and with clients to ensure effective communication and alignment. Provides financial oversight and budget management, controlling costs and maximizing project profitability. title: Analista financeiro

Qualificações deve possuir domínio em planejamento financeiro finanças corporativas e elaboração de orçamentos. necessário apresentar boas habilidades analíticas capacidade de interpretar dados financeiros e transformar informações em insights para decisões. é importante ter conhecimento em demonstrações financeiras e relatórios financeiros incluindo elaboração análise e consolidação. desejável formação em administração economia contabilidade ou áreas relacionadas além de experiência prévia na área financeira. será considerado diferencial conhecimento em sistemas de gestão financeira e planilhas eletrônicas além de organização atenção a detalhes e postura ética.

title: Supervisor operacional

title: Senior geotechnical engineer
description: Are you looking to grow professionally in a company where you can become a partner? Our core values are the Client, the Individual and Professional Development. ABOUT US IDOM is an Association of Professionals whose activity focuses on delivering Engineering, Architecture and Consulting projects that contribute to a more sustainable world. At IDOM, we are connected through our work and through ownership of the Firm, and we cooperate to achieve our highest professional and personal development while providing the best service to the Client. For this reason, IDOM's fundamental asset is the talent and experience of its people. Highly qualified professionals with strong human values, deeply united and working within a framework that respects their professional identity and freedom, with a strong ambition for progress, development, service and innovation. Since our foundation in 1957, we have grown continuously and are now a multidisciplinary, integrated international organisation, present in 130 countries, where more than 4,300 people carry out their professional work. Are you ready to take the next step? If you join our TEAM, you will be able to develop your career at the highest level in an environment of deep trust and professional respect. If you share our philosophy and would like to be part of our company, send us your CV. We would love to meet you!

title: Customer support geoscientist
description: Position Summary You will join Bluware, a wholly owned subsidiary of CMG (Computer Modelling Group) in Brazil as a dedicated resource supporting Petrobras, working at the intersection of technical support, geophysics, and client engagement, as part of Bluware's Customer Support Team. Your primary responsibility will be to provide in-person and remote support for Interactiv AI in close collaboration with the broader support and technical teams. This role involves assisting users with their workflows and ensuring a high standard of customer experience and satisfaction. Your core support responsibilities will focus on helping customers apply AI-assisted seismic interpretation workflows using Interactiv AI. For this reason, a strong foundation in seismic interpretation is essential. Strong problem-solving and communication skills, combined with a customer-focused mindset, are important. You will also work closely with the technical lead and the clients to assist in understanding customer needs, support the development of case studies, and contribute to initiatives aimed at increasing software adoption and improving product performance. The feedback and insights gathered through these activities will contribute to the continuous improvement of Interactiv AI and to Bluware's broader development efforts in Brazil. Success in this position will require you to develop and maintain a deep understanding of Bluware's technology and its applications. Bluware will provide the necessary software and domain training to help you reach the required level of expertise quickly and continue developing in the role. Key Responsibilities Provide timely and effective on-site and remote support to the client, as well as diagnose and resolve software-related issues. Work closely with the Technical Leader to support customer engagements, user training sessions, and participate in technical consulting activities. Identify and analyze software issues, escalating to support team or product team when necessary. Ensure issues are fully documented, tracked, and communicated clearly to clients. Gather user feedback and identify recurring issues or improvement opportunities. Note: This description reflects the general nature of the role. It's not a complete list of responsibilities—we believe in flexibility, initiative, and growing together. Required Qualifications Graduated in Geophysics or Geology. Good grounding in 2 D and 3 D seismic interpretation, including experience with horizon and fault interpretation, seismic attributes, and familiarity with well ties, stratigraphy, and basin analysis. At least 3 years of experience in seismic interpretation projects (industry or academia), including hands-on experience developing case studies from interpretation work. Strong problem-solving skills. Excellent interpersonal, communication, and collaboration skills. Ability to work directly with clients. Ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams. Fluent in Portuguese and English (spoken and written), with strong communication skills for technical discussions. Based in Rio de Janeiro, with authorization to work in Brazil. Preferred Qualifications Previous experience in a client-facing or support role. Master's or Ph D in Geophysics or Geology with focus on seismic interpretation projects is a plus. Exposure to seismic interpretation projects with O& G companies. Experience with Pre-Salt or Brazilian Equatorial Margin is a plus. Knowledge about AI is a plus. Key Skills Client relationship management and customer satisfaction Seismic interpretation expertise (2 D & 3 D) Consultative, service-oriented communication Training delivery and technical consulting Problem solving and troubleshooting Cross-functional collaboration Issue documentation and case study development Scope of Support The role focuses on: Providing on-site and remote support for Interactiv AI. Assisting customers with AI-assisted seismic interpretation workflows. Supporting user training sessions and technical consulting activities. Interpreting seismic data and developing case studies that demonstrate Interactiv AI's value and support software adoption. Gathering client feedback to support continuous product improvement.

Upload supporting documents and applications for online‑filed cases. Submit finalized case packets for attorney review using Airtable workflows. Client & Evidence Management Collect client signatures on all forms and declarations. Gather and upload psychological evaluations. For SIJS cases, collect signatures on GC‑211s. Strong writing skills for drafting affidavits, cover letters, and formal requests. Solid understanding of immigration case components and evidence requirements. Excellent organizational and time‑management abilities. Skilled in tracking signatures, evaluations, and supporting documentation. Strong communication skills for client coordination and internal collaboration. Comfort using Airtable, PDF tools, and online filing systems. What We Offer: Competitive pay above market rate. Comprehensive training. Paid vacation + sick leave. Your birthday off. U. S. paid holidays. Mon–Fri, 9 AM–6 PM PST. A mission‑driven, inclusive, supportive team.

Plan and coordinate co-marketing initiatives, partner campaigns, events, activations, content promotion and online/offline promotional projects. Adapt global briefs and materials to the needs of Brazil and other Latin American markets, ensuring local relevance and compliance with brand guidelines. Coordinate deliverables with internal and external stakeholders, including partners, agencies, public relations teams, influencers and vendors when applicable. Track execution and results, gather evidence of delivery and prepare reports with learnings and recommendations. Required qualifications At least 3 years of experience in business development, partnerships, commercial roles, partnership marketing or related functions. Hands-on experience in B2 B prospecting, relationship management, proposal preparation and follow-up of negotiations or partner projects. Fluent or native Portuguese. Professional English, with the ability to participate in meetings, prepare presentations and communicate with international teams. Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, set priorities, meet deadlines and keep stakeholders informed. Strong verbal and written communication, negotiation, organization and relationship-building skills. Availability to collaborate across time zones and travel occasionally within Brazil and Latin America. Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, International Relations, Economics or a related field. Proficiency in Power Point/Google Slides and Excel/Google Sheets; familiarity with CRM and project-management tools is preferred. Preferred qualifications Experience in streaming, entertainment, television, media, telecommunications, technology or digital platforms. Professional Spanish for communication with partners across Latin America. Existing relationships with broadcasters, telecom operators, platforms, agencies, brands or other potential partners. Knowledge of licensing, revenue-share, subscription bundles, co-marketing and media/barter models. Mandarin Chinese. Health insurance plan, meal/food allowance and life insurance. 30 calendar days of paid annual leave, 13th-month salary, FGTS, INSS and other statutory benefits under Brazilian law. Applicable statutory leave and occupational health examinations.

title: Consultor de vendas

Estamos procurando outro perfil: quem aprendeu a vender olhando no olho. Quem rodou estrada, bateu meta, ouviu centenas de \"não\" e vendeu quando ninguém queria comprar. Representante comercial, vendedor externo, executivo de contas, consultor B2 B - gente que talvez nunca tenha vendido um curso online, mas sabe convencer pessoas. O digital a gente ensina. Caráter, disciplina e vontade de vencer, não. Não estamos contratando apenas vendedores. Estamos procurando três pessoas e uma delas vai assumir a liderança comercial da empresa. A promoção não será por tempo de casa nem por amizade. Será por desempenho. Trabalhe de qualquer cidade do Brasil , dentro de uma operação digital em crescimento. Contrato PJ. Procuramos quem: Vendeu na rua, no balcão ou pra empresas Bateu meta de verdade Assume responsabilidade e não joga a culpa no lead Quer crescer por mérito Não contratamos currículo. Contratamos gente que resolve problema. Se é você, se candidate. O processo é exigente, de propósito.

title: Business development manager

As a rapidly growing company, we are looking for talented individuals committed to helping us achieve our goals. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a team of driven individuals dedicated to making a difference in the industry. Business Development Manager Responsibilities： -Proactively recruit and develop effective local partnerships with merchandise partners, manufacturers, and brands. Focus on categories selections to increase overall value, in alignment with business and customer needs. -Assist merchandise partners in establishing themselves on the platform and their growth. Guide merchandise partners in developing comprehensive plans including market positioning, product planning, brand marketing, and operational strategies. -Propose innovative ideas based on the current status of the categories, as well as create and implement projects through resource integration and merchant guidance. -Conduct industry analysis reports, explore potential customer needs through data analysis, and adjust strategies accordingly based on market trends. Required Skills： - 5+ years of operational experience, including but not limited to experience in brand management or platform operations. - Extensive connections and relationships with local seller and vendor networks is a plus. - Strong data analysis skills, able to analyze industry trends and project management through data, and summarize conclusions. - Possesses market exploration and marketing innovation capabilities, capable of guiding overall merchant marketing plans. - Excellent problem-solving skills, self-motivation, ability to think strategically and adapt quickly to changes. - Ability to work under pressure and manage logistics during high-demand periods.

title: Interpreter
description: WE ARE HIRING POLISH INTERPRETERS!!! Candidate Qualifications: Fluency in English and Polish Minimum 1 year interpretation experience preferred but not required. Ability to explain certain cultural concepts to avoid miscommunication with permission or at the request of the client. Technical Requirements: Computer or Laptop Windows 10 or higher USB Wired headset Steady wired internet connection Additional information: Remote position, interpreter works from his/her home office Ongoing training and competency opportunities Monthly payments Per minute rate **Based on your location, language testing and background check may be required**
