title: Cozinheiro(a)
description: Venha viver nosso propósito! Na Hyatt, somos movidos pelo propósito de "cuidar das pessoas para que elas possam ser o seu melhor". Nossa promessa está em entregarmos grandes experiências para nossos clientes, colegas e para a sociedade baseada em nossos valores. · Ser íntegro nos torna diferentes pois estamos prontos para falar e aceitar a verdade, honrando com os compromissos, responsabilidades e orgulho; · Somos empáticospois antes de qualquer coisa, nos colocamos no lugar das pessoas com compaixão e honestidade; · Buscamos a todoinstante ver as coisas de uma forma diferente, nos tornando criativos, curiosos e experimentando sem medo. Acreditamos que as falhas existem e são elas que nos levam ao sucesso mais cedo; · Prezamos por umambiente de descontração, rimos alto e geramos a alegria em nosso ambiente de trabalho. Cultivar um ambiente saudável, alegre e de bem estar é a chave para um serviço de excelência! Estamos em busca de um(a) Cozinheiro(a) talentoso(a), comprometido(a) com a excelência e apaixonado(a) pela arte da gastronomia para integrar a equipe. O(a) profissional será responsável pela preparação e apresentação de pratos de alta qualidade, seguindo rigorosamente os padrões gastronômicos, de segurança alimentar e de hospitalidade da marca. Principais Responsabilidades Preparar e finalizar pratos conforme fichas técnicas, receitas e padrões estabelecidos pelo Chef de Cozinha. Garantir a qualidade, apresentação e consistência dos alimentos servidos. Executar atividades de produção, pré-preparo, cocção e montagem dos pratos. Monitorar o armazenamento, conservação e validade dos insumos. Cumprir as normas de higiene, segurança alimentar e boas práticas de manipulação de alimentos. Apoiar o controle de desperdícios e a utilização adequada dos ingredientes. Organizar e manter limpas as áreas de trabalho, equipamentos e utensílios. Colaborar com a equipe de cozinha para assegurar uma operação eficiente e um excelente atendimento aos hóspedes. Participar da produção para restaurantes, room service, eventos, banquetes e demais serviços gastronômicos do hotel. Contribuir com sugestões de melhorias nos processos e na apresentação dos pratos. Requisitos Ensino Médio completo. Formação em Gastronomia ou cursos na área será considerada um diferencial. Experiência prévia como Cozinheiro(a), preferencialmente em hotéis, resorts, restaurantes de alto padrão ou gastronomia premium. Conhecimento de técnicas culinárias, manipulação de alimentos e controle de qualidade. Familiaridade com normas de segurança alimentar e vigilância sanitária. Disponibilidade para trabalhar em escala, incluindo finais de semana e feriados. Benefícios: Plano de Saúde Amil co-participativo e extensivo a 2 dependentes (filhos até 21 anos e cônjuge) e Odontológico Amil (conforme cobertura contratada, extensivo a dependentes); Seguro de Vida; Vale Transporte ou Auxílio Combustível de acordo com as suas necessidades; Well Hub para atividades voltadas para saúde e bem-estar; Uniforme lavadoe passado em nossa Lavanderia; Alimentação realizada no hotel; Kit recém-nascido; Convênio com Drogaria Pacheco; Convênio com instituições de ensino Superior, cursos de idioma e Informática; Parceria com restaurantes próximos ao hotel; Desconto nos serviços oferecidos pelo hotel (Restaurantes e SPA); Desconto em ótica; Oportunidades de Encarreiramento; 12 diárias ao ano em qualquer hotel da marca Hyatt com direito a 2 acompanhantes, após o período de experiência Pensamos em benefícios que impactem positivamente o bem-estar e saúde de nossos colaboradores, então também oferecemos: Atendimento médico e psicológico gratuito no hotel (conforme agendamento) Sessões de Shiatsu gratuitas no hotel (conforme agendamento) Parceria com plataforma Psicologia Viva, com sessões gratuitas Manicure e Pedicure (conforme agendamento) Barbeiro (conforme agendamento) Depilação (conforme agendamento) Acreditamos na construção de um ambiente inclusivo. Por isso, todas as nossas oportunidades são extensivas a pessoas com deficiência (PCD).

title: Dgb americas training manager south latam
description: DGB Americas Training Manager – South LATAM DOLCE & GABBANA Beauty Location : Brazil Reporting to: Education Senior Manager Role Mission We are seeking a dynamic, strategic, and hands-on Training Manager to lead all education initiatives across South LATAM. This individual will be responsible for elevating brand knowledge, retail excellence, and client experience across Fragrance, Makeup, and Skincare categories The role acts as the regional guardian of training excellence, ensuring that all distributor and travel retail markets are aligned with global brand standards while adapting programs to local needs. This person will not only execute training programs but also build long-term capabilities within distributor teams, driving sell-out performance and brand desirability in the region. Key Responsibilities 1. Regional Training Strategy & Execution Own and execute the education strategy across South LATAM distributors and TR markets for fragrance, makeup, and skincare categories. Adapt global training materials into impactful, locally relevant training modules (in-person and digital). Develop and manage the regional training calendar, ensuring alignment with product launches and commercial priorities. Deliver high-quality training across key markets, ensuring consistency and excellence in execution. Manage the training budget for the region, ensuring efficient allocation of resources aligned with business priorities. Partner and maintain close communication with Fashion boutique teams to execute training initiatives, ensuring alignment with brand standards and elevating client experience. 2. Distributor Partnership & Capability Building Act as the main education liaison for distributors across South LATAM. Train and coach local trainers and retail teams to ensure scalable knowledge transfer. Track training effectiveness through KPIs (sell-out, engagement, certification rates) and implement improvements. Tailor training approaches based on market maturity, cultural nuances, and business needs. 3. Brand & Product Expertise Serve as the regional expert across fragrance, makeup, and skincare, ensuring deep product and brand storytelling knowledge. Lead all training-related aspects of product launches, ensuring teams are fully prepared prior to market activation. Elevate in-store execution standards through coaching on client experience, selling techniques, and service rituals. 4. Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner closely with Sales and Marketing teams to align training initiatives with business objectives and sell-out targets. Collaborate with Communications, Digital, and Trade Marketing teams to ensure a consistent brand message across all touchpoints. Maintain alignment with brand DNA and guidelines. 5. Innovation & Continuous Improvement Drive adoption of digital learning platforms and hybrid training formats (virtual, e-learning, etc.). Identify and share best-in-class training practices across markets to elevate regional performance. Gather feedback from the field to continuously refine training content and approach. Requirements & Skills 5+ years in Training/Education within the beauty industry (fragrance, makeup, and skincare preferred). Strong understanding of LATAM markets Proven ability to design and deliver engaging training programs to diverse audiences. Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage and influence different stakeholders. Solid understanding of retail environments, client experience, and sales drivers. Fluent in English, Spanish and Portuguese . Willingness to travel frequently across South LATAM

title: Pessoa analista de contas a receber - temporário
description: Pessoa Analista Financeira - Contas a Receber (Temporário) Sobre a CBO: Somos a segunda maior empresa, em número de embarcações, do Brasil, no segmento offshore, com mais de 40 anos de tradição, inovação e pioneirismo. Nossos principais valores são segurança, sustentabilidade, integridade, atendimento, resultado, inovação e gente. Valorizamos a diversidade e a inclusão, e buscamos criar um ambiente cada vez mais diverso e seguro para todas e todos. Responsável pelo cadastro dos contratos, no SAP Ariba, por meio de analise e validação de todas as cláusulas contratuais referentes ao faturamento, como valor das diárias, impostos e reembolsos antes de cadastrar os contratos no SAP e reportar ao Comercial, qualquer divergência encontrada; 3. Auxiliar na realização e envio de SWAP Consolidação das prévias de diárias realizadas no mês, através das informações dos pontos focais de Operações, para envio ao setor de Estrutura de Capital; 5. Auxiliar no suporte as gerências de operações, conforme a solicitação dos clientes, por meio de envio de relatórios de medição, controle de diárias e demais reportes; 7. Responsável pelo controle e emissão das certificações de conteúdo local das embarcações da Cia, sendo o contato direto com a certificadora, através do envio de BMs, NFs de consumíveis (óleo, lubrificante etc.) e folha de pessoal (FOPAG, fichas de registros e relações de empregados), além da validação das informações apuradas antes da emissão do certificado; 8. Auxiliar na realização e reporte do faturamento e recebimento apurado no mês, através do apoio na criação e atualização de relatórios de acompanhamento do faturamento e recebimentos ao BNDES, Gerência e Diretoria; 9. Responsável pelo fluxo de pagamentos aos clientes externos (mensal e sob demanda), desde a solicitação da fatura ao fornecedor, execução de requisição de compras e folhas de serviço, além de diligenciar os pagamentos; 10. Atendimentoa auditoria, mediante a entrega de relatórios, disponibilização de documentos solicitados e esclarecimentos de dúvidas e questionamentos; 11. Apoio nas análises, através da conciliação de todas as contas da área, análise mensal das contas contábeis do Contas a Receber, alertando e justificando à Supervisão sobre as divergências encontradas nos lançamentos. Requisitos necessários: Formação: Contábil, Administração ou demais áreas financeiras; Conhecimento intermediário/avançado em Excel; Experiência prévia com contas a receber. O que oferecemos para você: Vale Alimentação e/ou Refeição Plano de Saúde Plano Odontológico Seguro de Vida Plano de Previdência Privada Acesso ilimitado a plataforma Psicologia Viva Total Pass Auxílio Creche Quer conhecer mais do Grupo CBO? Acesse nossas redes sociais e confira! title: Clinical & marketing specialist
description: Our client is a leading balloon catheter research, development, production, and sales enterprise, possessing globally leading balloon catheter technology and manufacturing capabilities. Since its establishment over a decade ago, the company has grown to a large scale, with R& D centers, operational centers, and production bases established worldwide. Responsibilities Provide on-site clinical support during interventional procedures, including PTCA, PTA, and interventional accessories, with a strong focus on coronary specialty balloons such as specialty scoring and CTO balloon products. Support distributors and physicians during case coverage, product demonstrations, and technical guidance in catheterization laboratories. Manage and develop key hospitals and key opinion leaders (KOLs) within assigned regions, ensuring continuous clinical follow-up and strong professional relationships. Work closely with the sales team and distributors to support regional sales objectives; proactively assist in product positioning, clinical adoption, and procedure planning. Participate in and support major medical congresses, workshops, live cases, and training programs, including booth support and academic promotion. Deliver clinical training and product education to distributors, sales representatives, and healthcare professionals. Collect and provide market intelligence, competitive insights, and clinical feedback from the field to support marketing and product strategy. Assist in the launch of new products and support post-market clinical follow-up. Ensure all activities comply with local regulations, company policies, and compliance standards. Qualifications Language proficiency: High-level command of a local language Ability to communicate in English for basic work-related communications (for collaboration with headquarters) Industry background: Relevant experience in healthcare sectors such as medical practitioners, nurses, pharmaceutical representatives, medical device/pharmaceutical distributors Preference given to candidates familiar with local healthcare systems, distribution channels, and client needs Core qualities: Passionate about sales work, goal-oriented, results-driven Strong self-motivation and adaptability to remote work modes Excellent communication skills and customer service awareness

title: Planejador financeiro / consultor de investimentos (pessoa física)

Essa vaga é direcionada a assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma. Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil e ao que você busca, inscreva-se! Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática. Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento. Responsabilidades: Prospectar, conduzir reuniões, entender o cliente e alinhar expectativas; Coletar todos os dados necessários e realizar a venda do serviço; Revisar o projeto financeiro ou patrimonial personalizado feito para cada cliente; Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos/ soluções e tirando dúvidas; Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos; Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes. Pré-requisitos: Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre; Proatividade orientada a resultados; Interesse em receber e dar feedback; Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia; Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos; Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma. Diferencial: Certificação CFP®, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas. Você terá: Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos; Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual; Programa de partnership estruturado; Treinamentos exclusivos; Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada; Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras; Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados; Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica; Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital; Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador; Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente. Modo de contratação: Primeiros 3 ou 6 meses → Contrato de prestação de serviços Após alcance dos critérios → Associado ao Grupo Capital Caso você acredite que essa oportunidade se alinha ao que você busca, inscreva-se!

title: Remote commercial lawyer - brazil
description: About Moritz Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match. We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work. We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team. Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart. title: Designer de conteúdo com ia pleno
description: Sobre a Payfy A Payfy é uma fintech B2 B que está redefinindo como empresas operam financeiramente no Brasil. Com cartões corporativos e tecnologia integrada, eliminamos relatórios de despesas, reduzimos complexidade administrativa e simplificamos a contabilidade de empresas de médio e grande porte. Temos uma cultura IA First de verdade — não como slogan, mas como jeito de trabalhar. Aqui, IA é ferramenta do dia a dia: quem entra precisa não só usar, mas saber usar com propósito. Sobre a vaga: Designer de Conteúdo com IA é quem projeta, produz e publica o conteúdo da nossa plataforma de transformação com IA para times financeiros — do começo ao fim. Projetar vem primeiro, e é o que define a função: pensar a pauta antes de executá-la, decidir se ela vira carrossel ou vídeo, onde ela entra no calendário e o que precisa dizer. Depois vem a execução — desenhar a peça, editar o vídeo, escrever a copy e colocar no ar. Tudo com a mesma pessoa, do início ao fim. É uma posição nova no mercado e já é realidade aqui: a Payfy tem profissionais no time atuando exatamente assim. O que torna esse escopo possível é a forma como a gente trabalha. Ferramentas de IA generativa (Claude/Claude Design, entre outras) estão na rotina diária e absorvem a parte mecânica da execução — variações de peça, primeiro corte, versões de copy, adaptação de formato. Some a isso um acervo de vídeo já montado (padrões de título, vinheta, GC, mockups, backgrounds animados) e um sistema visual definido: você quase nunca começa do zero. Por isso o perfil é generalista: repertório em design, vídeo e social media, e critério para decidir o que publicar, em que ordem e com que cara. É aí que seu tempo vai — o trabalho braçal fica com a IA. Você vai ter autonomia real sobre a operação e apoio direto de quem já construiu todo o padrão visual e narrativo da marca. O que você vai fazer: Calendário e planejamento Montar o calendário editorial mensal Traduzir temas, lançamentos e novidades da plataforma em pautas de conteúdo Manter a régua de publicação rodando de forma previsível, sem depender de demanda chegar Produção visual Criar carrosséis, posts estáticos, stories e peças para mídia paga dentro da identidade da marca Produzir capas de conteúdo para a plataforma (cursos, aulas, eventos) Manter rigor estético e consistência de marca em tudo que sai Vídeo Editar as videoaulas e conteúdos diversos a partir de um acervo de assets já prontos Realizar cortes, encaixes, montagem e exportação Apoiar novas gravações quando entrarem no calendário Publicação e acompanhamento Agendar e publicar via MLabs e canais próprios Conferir se a postagem subiu, se ficou correta, se precisa de ajuste Contribuir com ideias para materiais ricos (e-books, planilhas, ferramentas usadas como isca) O que a gente espera de você: Requisitos Experiência prévia montando calendários de social media (não apenas executando peças) Experiência prévia editando vídeo — domínio dos princípios de enquadramento, ritmo e montagem Boas noções de design: hierarquia, contraste, uso de cor, composição. title: Especialista em operações cripto e carteiras digitais
description: Sobre a vaga Se você já perdeu o sono acompanhando uma liquidez secar numa DEX às 3h da manhã, ou já organizou uma migração de fundos entre cold wallets sem deixar ninguém dormir tranquilo até a confirmação final na blockchain — essa vaga é para você. Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional experiente para assumir as operações críticas de ativos digitais da empresa: exchanges, carteiras e custódia. Não é uma posição para quem está começando na área. É uma função de responsabilidade real, com acesso a ativos reais, decisões que importam e impacto direto no negócio. O que você vai fazer Executar e supervisionar operações em exchanges centralizadas (CEX) e descentralizadas (DEX) — negociação, transferências, liquidez e reconciliação Gerenciar hot wallets e cold wallets no dia a dia, garantindo segurança operacional sem travar a velocidade do negócio Administrar estruturas multi-sig e processos de custódia, incluindo definição e revisão de políticas de acesso e aprovação Monitorar exposição, saldos e movimentações de ativos cripto em tempo real Criar e aprimorar processos internos de controle, segurança e auditoria para operações com criptoativos Atuar como referência técnica em questões de segurança de carteiras, gestão de chaves e prevenção de perdas Trabalhar em conjunto com times de compliance, financeiro e tecnologia para manter as operações sólidas e escaláveis Requisitos Experiência comprovada operando em exchanges cripto, tanto CEX quanto DEX Vivência prática com carteiras digitais — hot wallets, cold wallets, soluções multi-sig e custódia de ativos Histórico real de gestão de operações com criptoativos (não apenas conhecimento teórico) Rigor com segurança operacional: você entende que um erro nessa área pode custar caro, literalmente Autonomia para tomar decisões e comunicar com clareza em ambientes de alta responsabilidade Inglês para comunicação técnica é um diferencial O que oferecemos Remuneração: US$ 130.000 a US$ 150.000 por ano Plano de saúde completo , sem letras miúdas Modelo de trabalho flexível: remoto ou híbrido, conforme sua preferência Autonomia real para estruturar e melhorar processos, não apenas executar Um time que já entende do assunto — sem precisar explicar o que é gas fee Não importa a cor da pele, raça, gênero, orientação sexual ou qualquer outra característica pessoal. Avaliamos todos os candidatos exclusivamente pelo conhecimento e experiência. Se você respira mercado cripto e sabe a diferença entre segurança de verdade e segurança de fachada, queremos falar com você.

title: Corporate travel agent
description: Job Description: Senior Corporate Account Manager Company Overview: b Td Travel & Jets is a leading global concierge travel company with a presence in the US, Brazil, and Portugal and expanding to Spain and Mexico in 2025 and across Europe, Latin America, and GCC later. b Td operates under three innovative models: B2 C (exclusive membership services), B2 B (corporate travel management), and B2 B2 C (travel concierge services for business partners). Within the B2 B model, we specialize in delivering cutting-edge corporate travel management solutions through our b Td Corp Tool . This platform seamlessly blends intuitive technology with personalized services, simplifying business travel with exclusive rates on commercial flights, hotels, car services worldwide, with automated processes, and a focus on exceptional customer satisfaction. Beyond corporate travel, we also provide employees with access to b Td travel benefits and personalized concierge services for their leisure trips, enriching their overall travel experiences. CX Travel Specialist (2 positions: Either Early Morning Shift - From 4 AM to 13 PM Brazil time or From 4 PM to 1 AM Brazil time) We are looking for two (2) CX Travel Specialist to join our Customer Experience (CX) team. The ideal candidates are experienced with Amadeus and corporate travel management to support our global clients during night shifts. Main Responsibilities • Manage bookings for flights, hotels, and car rentals via Amadeus and other tools. • Handle client requests, changes, and special services via Whats App and email. • Process exchanges, refunds, EMDs, and monitor itineraries proactively. • Support VIP and C-level travelers with high-touch, discreet service. • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure accuracy and client satisfaction. Requirements • Experience in luxury or corporate travel. • Strong experience with Amadeus GDS (Air module) - Advanced level (An Amadeus Test will be conducted to verify level of proficiency before any job offer is sent) • Background in TMCs, agencies, or airlines. • Proficiency in English and Portuguese. Spanish is a plus. • Tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and flexible for night/weekend shifts. Exceptional verbal and written communication skills across multiple languages. Intermediate knowledge in NDC platforms is required. Effective training and delegation skills, with a \"learning by doing\" approach. Ability to navigate diverse geographic markets and cultural contexts effectively. • Knowledge of ARC (USA) and or IATA BSP accounting process is a plus Why Join Us • Work in a dynamic, global environment focused on service excellence. • Engage with high-profile clients and premium travel partners. • Be part of a collaborative, growth-oriented culture. • Enjoy a remote-first setup with flexible work arrangements b Td Travel Culture: At b Td, we are passionate about travel, bridging distances, connecting worlds, and creating unique experiences for our clients. We foster a culture that embodies entrepreneurship, hands-on collaboration, and teamwork. Our flexible work environment supports work-life balance, eliminating commuting time and offering opportunities for relocation or nomadic work. We are driven by a global mindset, a passion for client success, and a strong focus on results. Our environment values risk-taking, leadership development, and learning by doing, providing multiple opportunities for personal and professional growth. We respect diversity at all levels and embrace meritocracy, rewarding high performance and ensuring no space for toxic behavior or poor performance. b Td is committed to corporate governance, ethics, and mutual trust, building confidence through facts and evidence rather than perceptions. We promote an open, friendly, and respectful atmosphere where differences and preferences are honored. Join us and grow alongside b Td, with the opportunity to become part of the company’s evolution and stakes. Terms of Employment: Employment under CLT (Brazilian Labor Laws) . Remote work arrangement, with a 44-hour workweek Flexibility to travel domestically within Brazil and internationally to locations where b Td operates. This position is required or night shift and weekends, with flexibility. Excels in remote work for a global hybrid startup, combining tech-driven travel solutions with personalized services. Compensation: Competitive base salary. Night shift extra hours Performance-based bonuses and monthly premiums based on achieving KPIs. Sales commissions for achieving and exceeding targets. Health and dental insurance. Food card. Birthday day off. Opportunity for professional growth, with the potential to be promoted to Head of Corporate Globally as b Td evolves through its funding rounds. Access to travel-related perks and benefits as part of the b Td team. Important Note Before Applying: Let’s keep it real! Apply only if you meet at least 80% of the qualifications and can prove it with your Linked In profile or updated resume . We’re not looking for someone who just \"gets it\" — we need a self-starter ready to deliver results from day one . Forget gaming Linked In algorithms; we care about real achievements. If your experience matches the role and your profile shows your impact, we’re excited to hear from you, hire you fast, reward your contributions, and grow together. Note: Only candidates meeting the criteria will be contacted for an interview. Let’s keep it efficient and worthwhile for everyone! b Td Travel – Where Business Meets Innovation.

title: Senior aml investigations & case specialist
description: This role supports the MLRO in fulfilling the company's AML/CFT obligations by conducting local transaction monitoring investigations, screening reviews, case analysis, and suspicious activity assessments. The role is responsible for ensuring that investigative analysis, case documentation, and reporting recommendations are performed and maintained within Brazil in accordance with local regulatory requirements. Key Responsibilities Conduct investigations into transaction monitoring alerts, sanctions screening hits, and other financial crime cases relating to the Brazilian entity. Analyse customer activity and transaction patterns to identify suspicious activity and document investigative findings. Prepare and maintain complete investigation case files and supporting documentation. Support the MLRO in assessing and recommending suspicious transaction reports to Coaf. Perform local sanctions, PEP, and adverse media screening reviews where required. Escalate complex investigations, emerging risks, and material findings to the MLRO. Maintain accurate records of investigations and case decisions for regulatory and audit purposes. Work with global AML teams to obtain supporting intelligence while retaining ownership of the local investigative assessment. Support regulatory examinations, audits, and ongoing enhancement of AML controls and monitoring processes. Requirements Brazilian citizen with the legal right to work in Brazil. Must be based in Brazil 3–5 years of experience in AML, transaction monitoring, financial crime investigations, or compliance within a regulated financial institution, fintech, payment institution, or cryptocurrency exchange. Strong understanding of AML/CFT regulations, suspicious transaction reporting, and financial crime typologies. Experience with transaction monitoring systems, sanctions screening, and case management tools. Professional proficiency in Portuguese and English. Embraces AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, streamline compliance processes, and enhance the quality of regulatory analysis and decision-making. Profile Strong analytical and investigative judgement with excellent attention to detail. Able to make sound, risk-based decisions independently while maintaining high standards of documentation. Collaborative, hands-on, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment. Passionate about cryptocurrency, blockchain technology, and the evolving digital asset ecosystem, with a genuine curiosity to stay ahead of industry and regulatory developments.

title: Analista fp&a - sênior

Estamos em um momento de crescimento e estruturação da companhia, incluindo a preparação para atuação como Sociedade Prestadora de Serviços de Ativos Virtuais (SPSVA) . Buscamos um(a) Analista de FP&A para apoiar o planejamento financeiro, acompanhamento de resultados e análise de desempenho da companhia, transformando dados financeiros e operacionais em informações que apoiem a tomada de decisão. A posição terá atuação próxima à liderança e às áreas do negócio, com foco em planejamento, análise de resultados, projeções e construção de cenários . Requisitos Formação em Administração, Economia, Contabilidade, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas; 4–6+ anos de experiência em FP& A, Planejamento Financeiro, Controladoria ou áreas correlatas; Sólido conhecimento de P& L/DRE, fluxo de caixa, indicadores financeiros e análise de resultados; Experiência combudget, forecast e análise de variações; Domínio de modelagem financeira e construção de cenários; Excel avançado; Forte capacidade analítica e de interpretação de dados; Boa comunicação, com clareza e objetividade ao apresentar análises para diferentes públicos; Perfil analítico, organizado, curioso e orientado a resultados, com autonomia para conduzir suas entregas. Diferenciais Experiência em fintechs, instituições financeiras, empresas de pagamentos ou ativos virtuais; Experiência em ambientes regulados e/ou com o Banco Central; Conhecimento deoperações com criptoativos e stablecoins; Conhecimento de Power BI, Power Query e/ou SQL; Experiência comanálise de viabilidade e valuation de iniciativas; Inglês avançado; Conhecimento de operações internacionais. End-to-end deal experience. You've led transactions from term sheet through closing, not just supported workstreams. Deep familiarity with transaction documents — SPAs, APAs, disclosure letters, warranty and indemnity regimes, and completion mechanics. Due diligence command. You can scope, run, and synthesize a diligence exercise into findings a buyer can act on. Cross-border fluency. Comfortable coordinating with counsel in other jurisdictions on multi-country deals. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements. Why Moritz Run deals with modern tooling — faster diligence, cleaner documents, and clients who value speed and certainty. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure. Frequently Asked Questions How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz? Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client. What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform? Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding. Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network? No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work. How are co-counsel matched to client matters? Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

title: Designer de conteúdo com ia pleno
description: Sobre a Payfy A Payfy é uma fintech B2 B que está redefinindo como empresas operam financeiramente no Brasil. Com cartões corporativos e tecnologia integrada, eliminamos relatórios de despesas, reduzimos complexidade administrativa e simplificamos a contabilidade de empresas de médio e grande porte. Temos uma cultura IA First de verdade — não como slogan, mas como jeito de trabalhar. Aqui, IA é ferramenta do dia a dia: quem entra precisa não só usar, mas saber usar com propósito. Sobre a vaga: Designer de Conteúdo com IA é quem projeta, produz e publica o conteúdo da nossa plataforma de transformação com IA para times financeiros — do começo ao fim. Projetar vem primeiro, e é o que define a função: pensar a pauta antes de executá-la, decidir se ela vira carrossel ou vídeo, onde ela entra no calendário e o que precisa dizer. Depois vem a execução — desenhar a peça, editar o vídeo, escrever a copy e colocar no ar. Tudo com a mesma pessoa, do início ao fim. É uma posição nova no mercado e já é realidade aqui: a Payfy tem profissionais no time atuando exatamente assim. O que torna esse escopo possível é a forma como a gente trabalha. Ferramentas de IA generativa (Claude/Claude Design, entre outras) estão na rotina diária e absorvem a parte mecânica da execução — variações de peça, primeiro corte, versões de copy, adaptação de formato. Some a isso um acervo de vídeo já montado (padrões de título, vinheta, GC, mockups, backgrounds animados) e um sistema visual definido: você quase nunca começa do zero. Por isso o perfil é generalista: repertório em design, vídeo e social media, e critério para decidir o que publicar, em que ordem e com que cara. É aí que seu tempo vai — o trabalho braçal fica com a IA. Você vai ter autonomia real sobre a operação e apoio direto de quem já construiu todo o padrão visual e narrativo da marca. O que você vai fazer: Calendário e planejamento Montar o calendário editorial mensal Traduzir temas, lançamentos e novidades da plataforma em pautas de conteúdo Manter a régua de publicação rodando de forma previsível, sem depender de demanda chegar Produção visual Criar carrosséis, posts estáticos, stories e peças para mídia paga dentro da identidade da marca Produzir capas de conteúdo para a plataforma (cursos, aulas, eventos) Manter rigor estético e consistência de marca em tudo que sai Vídeo Editar as videoaulas e conteúdos diversos a partir de um acervo de assets já prontos Realizar cortes, encaixes, montagem e exportação Apoiar novas gravações quando entrarem no calendário Publicação e acompanhamento Agendar e publicar via MLabs e canais próprios Conferir se a postagem subiu, se ficou correta, se precisa de ajuste Contribuir com ideias para materiais ricos (e-books, planilhas, ferramentas usadas como isca) O que a gente espera de você: Requisitos Experiência prévia montando calendários de social media (não apenas executando peças) Experiência prévia editando vídeo — domínio dos princípios de enquadramento, ritmo e montagem Boas noções de design: hierarquia, contraste, uso de cor, composição. Você não precisa desenhar do zero, mas precisa saber enxergar quando algo está errado Boa escrita: headlines, copy de post, roteiro Disciplina para trabalho remoto — organização própria, cumprimento de prazos, comunicação ativa Disposição real para aprender ferramentas de IA e mudar a forma de trabalhar O perfil que a gente procura Visão macro de projetos Autonomia: pegar uma pauta e levá-la até a publicação, sem precisar de briefing mastigado a cada passo Organização e consistência Senso de dono Diferenciais Experiência com Adobe Premiere, After Effects, Cap Cut Familiaridade com Figma, Notion, MLabs Já ter usado ferramentas de IA generativa para produção de conteúdo Conhecimento de boas práticas de You Tube (SEO de descrição, configuração de publicação, leitura de retenção) Repertório em finanças/B2 B Como é trabalhar aqui: Remoto de verdade, com rituais definidos: alinhamento semanal com o time e encontros de acompanhamento com o gestor direto ao longo da semana Aprendizado estruturado, você vai lapidar seus conhecimentos em: MLabs, boas práticas de IA aplicada a conteúdo, padrão de edição dos vídeos, produto e marca Espaço para crescer Processo seletivo: Inscrição e triagem de currículo — RH Envio de portfólio — 3 peças autorais, sendo obrigatoriamente uma delas um vídeo editado por você Teste perfil comportamental (DISC) — RH Desafio prático — um projeto integrado e realista: uma peça de design, um carrossel, um vídeo curto e a copy/headline que amarra tudo, a partir de um tema que a gente entrega. O que a gente avalia aqui é sobretudo o raciocínio: como você estruturou o conjunto, não só o acabamento de cada peça Entrevista técnica — com o gestor direto, junto com a devolutiva do desafio Entrevista de liderança — com a liderança de Marketing O que oferecemos Contrato CLT — R$ 4.000,00 Vale alimentação ou refeição — você escolhe Assistência médica e odontológica 100% subsidiada pela empresa (após 3 meses) Day off de aniversário Wellhub + Conexa Saúde Time enxuto, decisão rápida e impacto visível Cultura IA First — você vai usar, evoluir e crescer junto com a tecnologia Diversidade e Inclusão na Payfy Você é livre para ser você. Valorizamos quem você quiser ser, independente de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência, orientação sexual, ascêndência ou idade. Se você leu até aqui e se identificou, queremos te conhecer. Mande sua candidatura com uma mensagem contando como você usa IA no seu trabalho hoje — isso importa mais do que você imagina.

Adaptation & Localization Adapt promotional scripts and ad concepts shared by the English team into Brazilian Portuguese. Localize scripts culturally and emotionally so they feel natural and relevant for the Brazilian audience. Maintain the original creative intent while improving clarity, relatability, and audience engagement for the local market. Ensure adapted ads do not feel like direct translations, but like native, market-ready promotional scripts. 3. Script Refinement & Quality Improvement Review and refine existing promo scripts to improve overall storytelling quality, pacing, emotional impact, and clarity. Strengthen weak openings, hooks, transitions, character motivations, and call-to-action moments. Improve scripts based on editorial feedback, performance insights, and creative direction. Ensure all final scripts are polished, coherent, and aligned with Pocket FM’s creative and quality standards. 4. Production-Ready Script Delivery Create production-ready promo scripts with clear structure, scene flow, dialogue, narration, emotional cues, and production notes wherever required. Ensure scripts are easy for voice-over artists, editors, and post-production teams to understand and execute. Provide clear direction on tone, pauses, dramatic moments, sound cues, and emotional delivery where needed. Support the production team by ensuring the script intent is preserved during execution. 5. Performance Reworks & Creative Hypotheses Analyze non-performing ads and suggest creative hypotheses for improvement. Recommend reworks based on possible issues such as weak hooks, unclear story setup, low emotional impact, poor pacing, or ineffective localization. Create alternate openings, revised structures, stronger cliffhangers, and improved audience entry points for underperforming promos. Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to test different ad angles and improve campaign performance. 6. Creative & Editorial Collaboration Work closely with editorial, production, localization, and performance marketing teams. Incorporate feedback quickly and deliver revised scripts within timelines. Maintain consistency in character, tone, story logic, and emotional continuity across promo assets. Contribute ideas for new promo formats, trailer structures, and ad angles that can improve audience response. 7. AI Tool Usage & Workflow Optimization Use Gen AI and writing tools where required to support ideation, adaptation, translation review, and script refinement. Apply strong human editorial judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets narrative, cultural, and quality standards. Review AI-generated outputs for tone, accuracy, cultural relevance, and storytelling strength. Use AI tools responsibly to improve speed and quality without compromising creative originality. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, Journalism, Film, or a related field. Strong writing and storytelling skills, especially for audio, ads, trailers, promos, or digital content. Excellent command of Brazilian Portuguese, with strong understanding of local cultural nuances, expressions, and audience preferences. Good understanding of English, with the ability to adapt English scripts and concepts into natural Brazilian Portuguese. Strong sense of narrative structure, emotional pacing, character motivation, hooks, and cliffhangers. Experience in promo writing, ad scriptwriting, trailer writing, fiction writing, audio storytelling, content localization, or digital performance creatives is preferred. Ability to write production-ready scripts with clear directions for voice-over and post-production teams. Ability to analyze feedback and performance signals to improve creative output. Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain quality across multiple deliverables. Comfortable working in a fast-paced content and performance marketing environment. Familiarity with AI-based writing, translation, or content adaptation tools is a plus. Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is a strong storyteller who understands how to turn an audio series into a compelling promotional experience. They should know how to grab attention quickly, build emotional curiosity, create drama, and write scripts that make audiences want to listen further. They should be equally comfortable writing original promo scripts, adapting English ads into Brazilian Portuguese, refining existing scripts, and suggesting creative reworks for ads that are not performing well.

High-Volume Learning Produce more ads in 6 months than most editors create in 2 years. Accelerate your skills exponentially. Application Process: Step 1: Submit Application Current CV/resume Portfolio link with 3-5 best DTC ads (Vimeo, Google Drive, or You Tube unlisted) Brief note (3-4 sentences) explaining which ad in your portfolio performed best and why you think it worked Step 2: Paid Test Project ($100 USD) Top candidates receive raw footage + a creative brief to produce a 30-60 second Meta ad. Turnaround: 48 hours. Step 3: Interview + Strategy Discussion 30-minute video call to discuss your creative process, workflow, and alignment with our brand. Step 4: Onboarding Start with a 2-week paid trial producing live ads for our campaigns. Applications without portfolio samples will be not be considered. Good luck! We are excited to meet you!

title: Remote investment lawyer - brazil
description: About Moritz Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match. We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work. We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team. Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart. The Role Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's venture and investment work in Brazil: seed and growth equity rounds, SAFEs and convertible instruments, term sheets, shareholder agreements, and secondaries. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of investment documentation for founders, startups, angels, and funds — on both the company side and the investor side. Run legal due diligence, manage closing processes and conditions precedent, and coordinate signing and completion. Advise on cap table structuring, employee option plans (ESOPs), governance and board matters, and investor rights. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA. What You'll Bring 5+ years practising venture capital, private equity, or corporate finance law in private practice or in-house. Deep familiarity with investment documentation — term sheets, subscription and shareholders' agreements, SAFEs and convertible notes, and articles / constitutional documents. Both-sides experience. You've acted for companies and for investors, and you know where each side's real risk sits. Fluency in startup economics. Liquidation preferences, anti-dilution, vesting, option pools — and how they interact across rounds. Speed with precision. Venture deals move fast; your documents still close cleanly. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements. Why Moritz Work with ambitious founders and funds on deals that move fast — supported by tooling that keeps pace. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure. Frequently Asked Questions How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz? Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client. What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform? Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding. Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network? No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work. How are co-counsel matched to client matters? Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms.

Acompanhar toda a legislação setorial, avaliando os impactos e os riscos regulatórios/econômicos sobre as atividades fins da empresa Administrar os contratos de venda de energia elétrica, controlar o pagamento das faturas de compra e venda de energia, bem como a realização de estudos, cálculos e processamentos com vistas a simular e recompor a contabilização da energia na Câmara de Comercialização de Energia Elétrica – CCEE, visando mitigar os riscos inerentes a esta atividade; Acompanhar as obrigações, registros de contratos e prazos da Câmara de Comercialização de Energia (CCEE), assim como as datas de pagamentos de obrigações financeiras. Por meio da lealdade de nossos clientes, que nos permitiu crescer expressivamente nos últimos anos, a Lockton hoje está entre as maiores corretoras de seguro do mundo, conquistando a taxa de crescimento orgânico mais rápida do mercado de corretoras. Principais responsabilidades: Gestão operacional dos benefícios de Saúde, Odontológico e Seguro de Vida; Realização de movimentações cadastrais, incluindo inclusões, alterações e exclusões de titulares e dependentes; Controle e processamento do faturamento dos benefícios, contemplando baixa de arquivos, conferência de rateios e envio para pagamento; Acompanhamento e controle do pagamento de faturas junto aos fornecedores; Monitoramento da maioridade de dependentes e orientação quanto às regras de permanência nos planos; Conferência e validação das bases cadastrais, identificando inconsistências, carências indevidas e oportunidades de saneamento de dados; Atendimento e orientação aos colaboradores sobre coberturas, elegibilidade, regras contratuais e regulamentações da ANS; Intermediação de demandas junto às operadoras e prestadores de serviço, acompanhando solicitações, liberações e tratativas administrativas; Suporte e acompanhamento de processos relacionados a cirurgias, internações e demais procedimentos de maior complexidade; Atuação preventiva na identificação de riscos operacionais e oportunidades de melhoria dos processos de benefícios; Elaboração de controles, indicadores e reports relacionados à gestão dos benefícios corporativos. Requisitos e Qualificações: Domínio de benefícios corporativos; Leitura, conferência e validação de faturas e subfaturas; Conhecimento das regras de elegibilidade, coberturas e movimentações de benefícios; Noções de legislação trabalhista aplicada a benefícios e regulamentações da ANS; Excel intermediário; Experiência em atendimento a colaboradores e interface com RH, fornecedores e operadoras.

title: Gtm education & community manager
description: We're hiring someone who walks into a room of founders and owns it by minute two. From there it is yours: what gets taught and to whom, how the community runs, where the whole thing goes next. The community Programming calendar, member journey, moderation standard Engaged participation as the number, not signups Members turned into content contributors Recurring interviews with our CEO, partners, and customers What you bring 3-5 years teaching or running education programs. B2 B Saa S strongly preferred End-to-end ownership of a training program, not delivery only Live teaching to a business audience Community building: a peer network, user group, or alumni cohort Hands-on with GTM tooling, enough to teach while using it AI in your daily workflow, with the judgment to review it. Raw AI output doesn't ship here Nice to have Microsoft partner, cloud marketplace, or co-sell motion GTM tools: Clay, Apollo, Lemlist Instructional design or adult learning LMS and community platforms: Circle, Teachable, Skilljar Portuguese, French, or Spanish fluency Details R$14,700 to R$20,600 per month, plus an end-of-year bonus Two recordings of trainings you have delivered in English, requested with your application Professional English (only English CVs will be considered) About We Transact Most companies in our space raise tens of millions and burn it chasing this market. title: Director of strategic partnerships
description: ABOUT ELIFE Elife is the unified API infrastructure behind global mobility and instant delivery across 182 countries. We power Super Apps, Fin Techs, neobanks, and ride-hailing ecosystems worldwide — we don't compete with them, we enable them. Our partners integrate once and serve their users globally. We build and operate the infrastructure. Our partners own the brand and the customer relationship. We do not compete for our partners' users. THE ROLE We are looking for a proven ecosystem hunter — not an account manager, not a loyalty program builder, not a co-marketing specialist. Someone who has personally closed bidirectional commercial deals where both parties share live transaction revenue, through API integrations with super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, or mobility companies. This is a greenfield, individual contributor role. You will build elife's LATAM pipeline from zero, own the full deal lifecycle from outreach to signed contract, and be expected to deliver active pipeline within the first 90 days. WHAT YOU WILL DO Identify, engage and close strategic partnerships with super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, ride-hailing operators and e-commerce ecosystems across LATAM Own the full commercial lifecycle — outreach, negotiation, deal structuring, contract execution and partner onboarding Structure and close revenue-share and API integration agreements where elife's infrastructure powers mobility and delivery services inside a partner's platform Build and maintain 20+ active enterprise prospects at any given time Engage C-suite and VP-level decision makers directly — no intermediaries Represent elife at industry events and forums across LATAM Report pipeline, forecasts and market intelligence directly to the VP of Partnerships WHAT WE NEED — NON-NEGOTIABLE 8+ years of B2 B enterprise partnerships experience Minimum 3 years of direct experience closing ecosystem deals with or inside super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, or ride-hailing companies in LATAM Proven track record closing bidirectional revenue-share deals — where revenue is generated by live transactions, not loyalty points, discount campaigns or co-marketing budgets Direct experience structuring and closing API integration partnerships commercially — owning the business case, commercial terms and deal execution end-to-end Active C-suite network verifiable with specific names in at least two of the following: Rappi, Uber, Di Di, Mercado Pago, Nu, Clip, Stori, Kavak, i Food or equivalent LATAM super apps or neobanks Multi-country LATAM experience — Mexico and/or Brazil required; Colombia, Argentina, Chile a plus Hunter DNA — you have built pipelines from zero, not inherited them Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese required; English proficiency required Bachelor's degree minimum; MBA strongly preferred PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Prior experience working with or for mobility platforms, ride-hailing operators, corporate travel or fleet technology companies Track record closing first-of-kind or complex ecosystem partnerships with measurable commercial outcomes Experience managing partnerships across multiple LATAM countries simultaneously Familiarity with the regulatory and payments landscape across Brazil, Mexico and Colombia WHAT WE OFFER Fixed monthly base + KPI bonus scalable up to 300% based on commercial results Uncapped commissions tied directly to the revenue you generate Remote-first with regional travel as required Direct access to C-suite and founder leadership from day one A genuinely entrepreneurial environment where your deals shape elife's growth trajectory in LATAM MARKET CONTEXT Latin America is one of the fastest-growing digital financial services markets in the world, led by Brazil and Mexico. The region is home to a dynamic ecosystem of super apps, neobanks, and ride-hailing operators actively seeking scalable mobility and delivery partnerships. The Director of Strategic Partnerships for LATAM will build elife's presence from the ground up in this high-potential, relationship-driven market — and earn accordingly.

title: Segment manager
description: Position Details Job Title: Antenna Sales Manager Department: Sales — Latin America Reports To: Regional Sales Director, LATAM Location: Brazil or Mexico — supporting the LATAM region Work Arrangement: Hybrid / Remote (home-office based, customer-facing) Employment Type: Full-Time Travel Required: Up to (40–50)% across the LATAM territory Role Objective Maximize Quectel’s LATAM market share and revenue for antenna products by developing new customers and verticals, accelerating antenna design wins, and enabling Regional Sales Managers to expand antenna penetration within the existing customer base. Primary Responsibilities Market Growth & New Business Own LATAM growth for Quectel antenna products and solutions, with a strong focus on new customer acquisition, new verticals, and share expansion. Build and actively hunt a prioritized funnel of target accounts with clear next actions, opportunity value, and design-win potential. Identify cross-sell opportunities within the existing Quectel customer base and partner with RSMs to position antennas alongside modules and connectivity solutions. Develop account strategies for OEMs, ODMs, and EMS providers whose products require cellular, GNSS, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth, or combination antennas. Customer & Design-Win Development Understand customer applications, RF/connectivity requirements, and program timing, and coordinate the right antenna solution. Track antenna evaluations, samples, technical discussions, qualifications, and design-in/design-win progress through the regional funnel. Initiate and schedule customer roadmap meetings to identify future programs and influence antenna selection early in the design cycle. Maintain strong follow-up with prospects and customers from initial opportunity through technical evaluation and commercial conversion. Sales Enablement & Channel Development Train Regional Sales Managers, representative firms, and distributors on Quectel antenna positioning, target applications, and sales messages. Create account-specific selling strategies and support local teams in advancing antenna opportunities. Provide competitive and market insights that help the wider sales organization win antenna business. Product & Internal Collaboration Work closely with Product Management and technical teams on customer requirements, product fit, competitive gaps, and future roadmap needs. Translate market feedback into actionable input for product planning and commercial strategy. Coordinate internal resources to move strategic opportunities through evaluation and decision stages. CRM, Reporting & Market Intelligence Maintain accurate and current account, opportunity, and activity information in Salesforce CRM. Prepare a monthly LATAM business review covering pipeline, leads, technical evaluations, meetings, risks, and next steps. Monitor market trends, competitors, target verticals, and major customer programs relevant to antenna growth in LATAM. Attend trade shows and industry events to identify target accounts and capture qualified contacts for follow-up. Qualifications & Experience What we are looking for (5)+ years of demonstrated success in B2 B technical sales, business development, or segment sales within antennas, RF components, wireless connectivity, Io T hardware, or a closely related field. Strong ability to prospect, build pipeline, develop new accounts, and drive opportunities toward design wins and revenue. Working understanding of customer design cycles and what it takes to win embedded hardware business. Comfort discussing antenna use cases across cellular, GNSS, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth, and connected-device applications. Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills across a multi-country sales region. Hands-on CRM discipline and clear funnel and business-review reporting. Fluent Portuguese and/or Spanish, plus professional working English. Willingness to travel across LATAM for customer meetings, partner development, and industry events. Preferred background Experience selling antennas, RF solutions, Io T modules, or related components to OEM/ODM/EMS customers. Existing relationships within LATAM Io T, industrial, telematics, or tracking ecosystems. Experience supporting distributors, representative firms, or channel partners. Ability to collaborate with Product Management, FAE, and engineering teams on technical evaluations. Familiarity with certification and homologation processes in LATAM markets (e.g., ANATEL, IFT). What Success Looks Like Growth in qualified antenna pipeline and new target accounts. Increase in antenna design-ins/design wins and commercial conversions. Higher antenna penetration across existing Quectel accounts. Strong RSM/channel enablement and opportunity follow-through. Accurate Salesforce funnel management and monthly reporting. Actionable market/competitive intelligence that improves sales execution. About Quectel Quectel’s passion for a smarter world drives us to accelerate Io T innovation. We are an end-to-end global Io T solutions provider, and our team of more than 5,800 professionals delivers cellular, GNSS, satellite, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth modules, high-performance antennas, and full turnkey offerings including ODM services and system integration. Founded in 2010 and headquartered in Shanghai, Quectel operates offices, R& D centers, and support teams across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM. Our antenna business combines a broad standard portfolio with full custom design support — simulation, testing, tuning, and manufacturing. Industries & Applications Quectel’s modules and antennas power innovation across: Smart metering and utilities Asset tracking, telematics, and logistics Smart agriculture Smart cities and infrastructure Industrial Io T and automation Connected mobility and automotive Smart home and consumer Io T Why Quectel LATAM? Global Impact, Regional Focus — Own a product line across Latin America, backed by a global organization with teams in APAC, EMEA, and North America. Career Growth — Mentorship, international exposure, internal mobility, and clear advancement paths. Cutting-Edge Technology — Next-generation 5 G, GNSS, NTN/satellite, and custom antenna solutions in mission-critical applications. Inclusive, Global Team — A multicultural workplace collaborating with Io T experts across engineering, sales, and operations. Compensation & Benefits Competitive base salary benchmarked to the local market in Brazil or Mexico Uncapped sales commission tied to antenna revenue and design wins in your territory Meal and grocery vouchers Private health insurance with no co-pay, extendable to dependents Dental coverage Life insurance and accident cover Paid time off plus statutory holidays, and paid parental leave per local law International exposure — HQ visits and global trade shows such as CES, Embedded World, and MWC Structured onboarding and ongoing product training, with internal mobility across a global organization Learn More Explore products, careers, and news at or follow Quectel Wireless Solutions on Linked In. Note: Responsibilities may evolve based on business priorities and market needs. Quectel is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic.

title: Recruiter/talent acquisition specialist (remote)
description: Schedule : 9am - 5pm EST | Mon - Fri Salary : $1,500 + $50m bonus English Level : You must have C2 English to qualify DO NOT APPLY UNLESS YOUR ENGLISH LEVEL IS ADVANCED About US Remotely+ connects growing U. S. companies with exceptional remote professionals throughout Latin America and the Caribbean. We support our clients throughout the hiring process — from understanding their staffing needs and sourcing talent to screening, interviewing, selection, and onboarding. As we continue to grow, we're looking for a resourceful, technology-driven recruiter who can help us identify great talent quickly while maintaining a high-quality candidate and client experience. About the Role We’re looking for a Recruiter / Talent Acquisition Specialist with experience in staffing, BPO, or high-volume recruitment , including experience recruiting talent throughout Latin America , who thrives in a fast-moving environment. This role requires an exceptionally high level of English proficiency, both written and spoken . You will be recruiting primarily for U. S.-based companies where English is the primary working language , so you must be fully comfortable conducting interviews, evaluating candidates’ English communication skills, writing professional candidate summaries, and communicating confidently with internal stakeholders and clients in English. This is not a role where you’ll simply post jobs and review applications. You'll manage multiple searches simultaneously, actively source candidates, screen and assess talent, maintain organized recruiting pipelines, and partner closely with our internal team to ensure we’re consistently presenting strong candidates to our clients. We’re especially interested in someone who knows how to use AI, recruiting technology, automation, ATS platforms (Zoho Recruit), and CRMs to work smarter and make recruiting processes more efficient. You should also be able to identify bottlenecks throughout the recruitment process and recommend practical ways to improve efficiency, candidate flow, and overall hiring outcomes. Because Remotely+ is growing, you'll also have the opportunity to help us improve, build, and refine recruiting processes as we scale. What You'll Do Manage multiple recruiting searches simultaneously across different industries and job functions. Source candidates through Linked In, job boards, databases, referrals, social media, and creative sourcing strategies. Review and screen high volumes of applications efficiently while maintaining strong hiring standards. Conduct initial candidate interviews and assess experience, communication skills, English proficiency, professionalism, and overall fit. Evaluate candidates against client requirements and identify the strongest profiles to move forward. Prepare candidate summaries, recruiter notes, and recommendations for internal and client review. Maintain accurate candidate records, stages, notes, communications, and activity within the ATS. Proactively build talent pipelines for frequently hired and hard-to-fill positions. Communicate with candidates throughout the recruitment process and provide a positive, responsive candidate experience. Identify bottlenecks in the recruitment process and recommend ways to improve efficiency. Help develop recruiting templates, screening processes, interview guides, assessments, workflows, and standard operating procedures as the company scales. Use AI and automation tools to increase productivity while maintaining human judgment and high recruiting standards. What We're Looking For 3+ years of recruiting or talent acquisition experience , ideally within staffing, BPO, recruitment agencies, outsourcing, or other high-volume hiring environments. Excellent written and spoken English. Proven experience managing multiple roles and large candidate pipelines at the same time . Experience recruiting talent throughout Latin America . ATS experience is a must and familiarity with Zoho Recruit as an ATS is a huge plus. Experience working in a staffing or recruitment agency environment. Experience recruiting for a variety of positions and adapting quickly to unfamiliar industries or job functions. Strong interviewing and candidate assessment skills. Ability to quickly identify whether a candidate truly meets the core requirements of a position. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Ability to prioritize effectively and work independently in a fast-paced environment. Comfortable working with recruiting metrics and using data to improve sourcing and hiring decisions. Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.

title: Gerente de operações logística

Vivência na gestão de centros de distribuição de alta complexidade, abastecimento de lojas e operações de distribuição. Forte experiência na liderança de gestores, coordenadores e grandes equipes operacionais. Histórico consistente de melhoria de indicadores de produtividade, nível de serviço, custos e eficiência operacional. Experiência com gestão orçamentária, planejamento operacional e tomada de decisão baseada em indicadores. Domínio de KPIs logísticos como OTIF, produtividade, acuracidade de estoque, nível de serviço, custo logístico, ocupação e eficiência operacional. Conhecimento em sistemas WMS, TMS, SAP e ERP.
